sessions.title: The evolution of the Microsoft Copilot app
sessions.desc: The Microsoft Copilot app is redefining how work gets done with AI. Hear from Microsoft product leaders about the latest innovations in the Copilot app and see these new experiences in action.

sessions.title: Automate the Follow-Through with Scout
sessions.desc: What if AI could keep work moving without the next prompt? Explore how Microsoft Scout works against goals, events, and signals to monitor what matters, surface risks and opportunities, and take proactive action with enterprise controls and human oversight. Through demos and real-world scenarios, learn where always-on automation fits, which use cases are ready, and how to prepare for adoption.

sessions.title: Evolution of Chat
sessions.desc: Explore how Copilot Chat is becoming a more capable starting place for AI at work. We’ll show how Chat can help people find information, reason through tasks, draft content, and move work forward across Microsoft 365, while keeping the experience simple, familiar, and grounded in the flow of work.

sessions.title: Beyond Chat: Delegate Complex Work with Copilot Cowork
sessions.desc: Real work changes when AI moves beyond chat to handle repeatable tasks and workflows. In this expert-led breakout, see how organizations use Copilot Cowork to delegate complex, multi-step work across apps, files, and business systems. Product demos and expert guidance will show where Cowork creates value, what to consider for implementation, and how to accelerate adoption.

sessions.title: Agentic productivity in Microsoft 365 apps
sessions.desc: The next wave of Microsoft Copilot innovation is transforming how work gets done across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Join us for a demo-heavy session showcasing emerging agentic experiences that help you move seamlessly from idea to outcome, with richer context, more connected workflows, and new ways to create, collaborate, and stay productive. Walk away with practical examples you can start using right away.

sessions.title: Copilot Notebooks: The evolution of Office in an agentic workspace
sessions.desc: Copilot Notebooks turns scattered files, meetings, emails, notes, and documents into a shared AI-powered workspace in the Microsoft Copilot app and OneNote. Explore our newest agentic Copilot Notebooks update that brings deeper M365 integration to your AI-workspace like: delegating and scheduling simple tasks, creating HTML files, editing documents, and more ways to collaborate and move work forward.

sessions.title: From Conversation to Completion: How Teams and Copilot move work ahead
sessions.desc: Collaboration has always been conversation, and the gap between deciding and doing is where time and momentum quietly disappear. See how Microsoft Teams, Copilot, and agents close it. Agents join your meetings, chats, and channels as teammates you @mention and assign work to, grounded in your context by Work IQ and governed by Agent 365. Learn from specific scenarios where coordination becomes built in, moving your team from fragmented work to coordinated execution.

sessions.title: The Next Generation of Teams Administration
sessions.desc: Be among the first to see the latest Teams and Teams Rooms administration innovations. Learn how Microsoft is reimagining IT administration with AI-powered experiences that help teams turn intent into action, accelerate troubleshooting, and simplify management at scale. Explore TCH Insights in TAC Copilot, Custom RBAC, Mobile Device Remote Log Collection, the Client Repair tool, and unified monitoring across meetings, calls, and rooms to drive more proactive operations.

sessions.title: Engineering the Frontier Firm: How Work IQ Powers Copilot
sessions.desc: Becoming a Frontier Firm requires more than deploying AI - it requires AI that understands how work gets done across your organization. Work IQ brings together both work and business data with semantic context to help Microsoft Copilot deliver more intelligent actions and outcomes for frontier organizations. Learn what's new in Work IQ, how Microsoft Copilot differs from other AI solutions, and how customers are creating measurable business impact.

sessions.title: Secure and Govern Microsoft Copilot and Cowork
sessions.desc: Microsoft Copilot and Cowork are transforming how employees and agents work together, creating new opportunities and new governance challenges. Learn how to secure, govern, and manage Copilot & Cowork across your organization using Microsoft's integrated security, compliance, and governance capabilities. We'll cover protecting sensitive data, reducing oversharing risks, meeting regulatory requirements, and gaining visibility into usage so you can confidently scale Copilot & Cowork adoption.

sessions.title: Trusting Autonomous AI: Security & Governance for Scout
sessions.desc: Microsoft Scout is a new category of AI agents that can act autonomously on behalf of users and organizations. As organizations move from AI that responds to AI that reasons, takes action, and completes tasks, security and governance become critical. Join Microsoft experts to learn how to securely deploy and govern Scout with enterprise-grade identity, data protection, compliance, visibility, and controls to scale adoption with confidence.

sessions.title: Defend Against External Threats in Teams
sessions.desc: AI-generated threats are becoming more convincing and disruptive. Discover how Microsoft Teams helps protect users with built-in detection for impersonation, voice phishing, and suspicious external activity across meetings, calls, and messaging. Learn how external collaboration protections and certified security partner integrations help identify untrusted participants, malicious content, and AI-powered threats before they become incidents.

sessions.title: Manage and Secure your AI Agents at Enterprise Scale with Agent 365
sessions.desc: Move from experimentation to AI agent adoption at scale. In this session, explore how Microsoft Agent 365, the control plane for agents, can help your organization operate and scale agents with confidence by providing comprehensive visibility, built-in governance, and enterprise-grade security across your AI ecosystem. See what's new with Agent 365 and learn how to accelerate agent adoption while maintaining trust, meeting compliance requirements, and keeping operational control.

sessions.title: Shadow AI won't wait: govern the AI agents you never deployed
sessions.desc: Learn how security and IT leaders confront a shift underway: employees install AI agents on your devices, and adoption outpaces control. Local agents act autonomously, inherit the permissions of whoever installed them, and evade controls built for conventional software. See how Microsoft Agent 365 composes signals Defender, Intune, and Entra already produce into one workflow: discover unmanaged agents, map them to devices and users, block or sanction into governance. Nothing new to deploy.

sessions.title: Multi-Model AI in Copilot: Optimize for performance, value, and trust
sessions.desc: No single AI model is best for every task. As AI innovation accelerates, organizations need to adopt the latest models without creating complexity for users, uncertainty for leaders, or risk for administrators. See how Microsoft 365 Copilot brings together model choice, Work IQ, cost management, and governance in one integrated platform. Learn how to apply the right model to the right work, measure the value of AI, and innovate confidently while maintaining security, compliance, and control.

sessions.title: Real-World AI Transformation with Copilot in SharePoint​‌
sessions.desc: Organizations are moving beyond AI experiments and into production. See how customers are using Copilot in SharePoint to modernize knowledge management, organize content at scale, automate business processes, preserve expertise, and strengthen Copilot experiences. Through real-world examples and customer stories, learn practical approaches for turning scattered content into organizational knowledge and transforming knowledge into action across the enterprise.

sessions.title: SharePoint: Modernize your knowledge foundation for the AI era
sessions.desc: Most organizations have the content they need, but it remains scattered across files, sites, and business processes. Learn how Copilot in SharePoint helps transform content into organizational knowledge by modernizing information architecture, enriching content with AI, scaling expertise through reusable skills, and strengthening Copilot and agent experiences across Microsoft 365.

sessions.title: AI in the Flow of Work: OneDrive for the AI Era
sessions.desc: As AI becomes part of everyday work, content plays a more important role than ever. Discover how OneDrive helps people find knowledge, organize information, collaborate across teams, and move from information to action with Copilot. Through practical demonstrations, explore new experiences that make it easier to work across files, libraries, and shared content while keeping work secure, connected, and ready for the flow of work across Microsoft 365.

sessions.title: Connect Once: Unlock enterprise knowledge with Copilot Connectors
sessions.desc: AI is only as powerful as the knowledge it can access. Learn how Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors help organizations connect enterprise data from content repositories, CRM, ITSM, and custom apps into Copilot and agentic workflows. See how reusable skills and a unified connector platform help users find information, take action, and unlock value from the systems they already use.

sessions.title: Govern Once, Use Everywhere: Scale Copilot with One Plugin Registry
sessions.desc: As Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility grows, governance can get complex. Learn how the Copilot plugin registry creates one source of truth for plugins, connectors, MCP servers, skills, and agents across Chat, Cowork, Scout, Code, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform. See how unified publishing, approval, security, and governance help IT reduce overhead, improve discovery, and scale trusted AI innovation.

sessions.title: Functional Copilot: Industry and role-based solutions at work
sessions.desc: Go deeper into how Microsoft 365 Copilot supports high-value industry and functional work. See how Copilot, skills, agents, connectors, and Microsoft 365 apps bring trusted business and industry data into everyday workflows across legal, life sciences, and more. Explore flexible, role-specific solutions across priority functions, with customer examples showing business impact.

sessions.title: Getting work done with Copilot as a small business
sessions.desc: Small businesses want outcomes, not setup. Join this session to see how Copilot plug-in packages bring pre-built skills, scenarios, and connections to key systems of record together in one turnkey experience. See demos focused on key outcomes—like month end accounting—to show how the right skills, integrations, and workflows light up instantly. We'll walk through the top SMB scenarios end to end, showing how to drive measurable outcomes. Leave this session ready to get work done with Copilot.

sessions.title: The AI Reality Check: What We’re Learning from Customers​
sessions.desc: What does AI transformation look like in the realities of an enterprise? Hear from Microsoft’s customer-facing teams on what organizations are experiencing as they put Copilot and AI to work. Explore the questions, challenges, and tradeoffs around trust, governance, adoption, readiness, and value, and learn how Microsoft works with customers to address them and move forward with confidence.

sessions.title: Why Copilot is the best AI for work
sessions.desc: Your organization is already using AI, but is it delivering real value at scale? In this session, we’ll compare Microsoft 365 Copilot to alternative AI solutions across real work scenarios. See how Work IQ, organizational context, multi-model intelligence, security, and trust work together to deliver more relevant results and higher-quality outcomes. Bring your laptop and evaluate the differences firsthand!

sessions.title: Building an AI Operating System: The Layers of Frontier Transformation
sessions.desc: Organizations often evaluate AI through individual tools and models, but lasting transformation requires an AI operating system, not a patchwork of offerings. In this session, we’ll explore the layers of Frontier Transformation: Infrastructure, Data, Context and Knowledge, AI Platform, Build Tools, and Security. You’ll see how these layers work together to enable enterprise AI at scale and gain a framework for evaluating AI platforms holistically.

sessions.title: What Microsoft Offering Is Right for Your Use Case?
sessions.desc: Most organizations know their goals; the hard part is finding the right path, resources, and investments to scale. Learn how to close that gap across everyday work, team productivity, business processes, data and app innovation, and security. Discover Microsoft offerings and benefits aligned to your priorities, use cases, and maturity stage.

sessions.title: The Frontier Firm Journey: Accelerate AI with Frontier Accelerate
sessions.desc: Discover how Frontier Accelerate helps organizations become Frontier Firms through Microsoft’s end-to-end approach to AI transformation. Learn how to 1) engage trusted Microsoft experts, 2) unlock targeted investments and funding to prove value sooner, and 3) use workforce skilling benefits to drive adoption and build capability. Hear how customers reduce risk, move from pilot to production, and scale AI. Leave knowing exactly which Microsoft resources to ask for, and when.

sessions.title: Fireside chat: How customers are unlocking value & growth with Copilot
sessions.desc: Real stories spark real transformation. Join Matt Firestone, General Manager of Microsoft Copilot, for a candid conversation with leaders putting Copilot to work at scale. You'll hear firsthand how their Frontier Firms are turning AI adoption into measurable value and growth—empowering employees and managing costs while transforming business process with agents—and walk away with actionable insights on becoming a Frontier Firm.

sessions.title: How Microsoft Connects Employees, Leaders, and Knowledge at Scale
sessions.desc:
In the AI era, trust is your organization's most important capability.
Join Microsoft Corporate Communications and product leaders to learn how Microsoft supports 200K+ employees through workplace transformation. Discover practical strategies to create clarity during change, build psychological safety, scale shared knowledge, and accelerate AI skills through leadership engagement, communities, Teams events, Copilot, and agents—and preview upcoming Viva Engage and Microsoft 365 innovations.
speakers: Sr. Director, Global Executive and Employee Communications

sessions.title: Functional and Industry Solutions with Microsoft Copilot
sessions.desc: Organizations are moving beyond AI experimentation to transform how work gets done. Microsoft and customers will showcase functional and industry solutions built on Microsoft 365 Copilot that redesign workflows, accelerate decisions, and drive business outcomes across sales, marketing, finance, operations, service, leadership, and industry scenarios. Learn how leaders identify high-value opportunities, align AI to strategy, and scale repeatable solutions across teams.

sessions.title: Beyond the Benchmark: How to Evaluate Enterprise AI
sessions.desc: How do you know which AI delivers the most value for your organization? Go beyond feature and price comparisons with a practical approach to evaluating AI across real work. See how side-by-side testing measures quality, accuracy, trust, and cost, and learn how to translate those results into an apples-to-apples view of AI value that can inform platform, deployment, and investment decisions.

sessions.title: Dynamics 365 in your flow of work with Copilot Cowork
sessions.desc: Act on business data without breaking your flow. See how Dynamics 365 plugins in Copilot Cowork bring context and action together across sales, service, finance, and operations, helping employees move work forward faster with fewer app switches.

sessions.title: Agents in Copilot: help every user get more done
sessions.desc: Getting value from agents takes more than deployment. Learn how to help users discover, trust, and use agents in Microsoft 365. See practical approaches for identifying the right use cases, guiding everyday workflows, and driving adoption so teams can get more value from Copilot and agents.

sessions.title: Plugins for Copilot: build once, govern once, use everywhere
sessions.desc: As organizations extend Copilot, skills, connectors, MCP servers, tools, and agents can create fragmented catalogs, publishing paths, and controls. Learn how Microsoft’s plugin ecosystem brings these capabilities into a shared lifecycle, from building and importing to publishing, discovering, deploying, governing, evaluating, and maintaining them across supported Copilot experiences. See how the pieces relate and what the model means for users, IT, developers, and partners.

sessions.title: Frontier tuning: Optimize AI agents for real-world business outcomes
sessions.desc: AI success depends on more than the model. Learn how Frontier Tuning helps organizations optimize models, tools, skills, knowledge, and evaluation frameworks to improve performance on real business workflows. See how Copilot Studio and Foundry work together to deliver better outcomes, higher quality, and improved cost efficiency at scale.

sessions.title: Employee Self-Service to Enterprise Scale: Managing Intelligent Agents
sessions.desc: Discover how Employee Self-Service (ESS) agents streamline IT and HR support, connect enterprise systems, improve response quality, and automate workflows. Go beyond deployment to drive adoption and manage governance, evaluation, analytics, and lifecycle operations at scale. Through customer stories and implementation lessons, learn practical patterns to reduce duplication, govern deployments, and scale intelligent, action-oriented support that improves employee experiences across your business.

sessions.title: Build and scale the next generation of AI agents in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.desc: See the complete journey from a developer’s first line of agent code to measurable business impact. Build locally with GitHub and VS Code, deploy to hosted agents, connect governed tools through Toolboxes, and ground agents across enterprise data with Foundry IQ. Then use tracing, evaluation, optimization, and cost and ROI insights to continuously improve quality and economics before publishing agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams.

sessions.title: How SThree is reimagining recruitment with human-led AI
sessions.desc: Most AI agents tackle a single task. SThree, a global STEM workforce consultancy, took a bolder approach with Microsoft and Foundry, building agents that work alongside consultants so people and technology each do what they do best. Human judgment stays at the center. SThree leaders and Microsoft's VP of Core AI Product Management discuss key lessons, the impact on consultants, and how amplifying human attention creates more time for relationship-building that drives business.
speakers: VP Products and AI Futurist, CoreAI

sessions.title: Build your self-improving AI Platform with Microsoft Foundry
sessions.desc: In a world of abundant models, winning means continuously adapting to customer context—not just choosing the best model. The hill-climbing machine connects inference, observability, evaluations, optimization, model selection, post-training, and RL into one learning loop. Every interaction improves quality, cost, and reliability, turning AI into a governed, self-improving business platform.

sessions.title: How much should you own? Choosing the right agent architecture
sessions.desc: Choose the right Foundry build path for each agent without creating a platform dead end. Start quickly with simple prompt agents, add the GitHub Copilot harness for skills, sandboxed execution, long-running work, and agent definitions managed as files through CI/CD, or use hosted agents when you need full control of your code and framework, including OpenClaw or Hermes. See how Foundry applies identity, authorization, governance, tools, and publishing across these paths, including autopilots.

sessions.title: Voice agents in Microsoft Foundry: Prototype to production in 45 mins
sessions.desc: Voice is the fastest-growing way people use agents, and the hardest to put in production. Voice-first agents in Microsoft Foundry give you one place to build a speech-native agent, ship it to web, mobile, Teams and telephony, and operate it with audio-aware tracing and evaluation. We'll cover what ships, how it differs from voice-enabling a text agent, and what enterprise customers are running today.

sessions.title: Content-aware agents with Content Understanding/Document Intelligence
sessions.desc: What if your AI agents could read documents, understand images, and process audio and video to act on business content? In this session, learn how Azure Content Understanding and Document Intelligence turn unstructured, multimodal content into actionable insights and automated workflows. Through live demos, see how to ingest content, extract structured data, and orchestrate AI agents using trusted enterprise content, spanning process automation, knowledge extraction, and agent-driven workflows.

sessions.title: From open weights to workload: Operationalizing at enterprise scale
sessions.desc: Open-weight models offer greater choice and control, but production at scale requires the right infrastructure, serving stack, and operations. See how Microsoft Foundry Managed Compute helps teams move from model selection to enterprise deployment. Learn from AT&T’s OTel 2.0 experience using multiple open models and GPU types to balance performance, economics, and workload needs without standardizing on one model.

sessions.title: Token economics: Get more from your production AI budget
sessions.desc: Make every token count with Microsoft Foundry. Learn to match workloads to models and inference tiers, reuse prompt caches, route requests intelligently, and handle capacity limits with smart fallbacks. Hear how WolterKluwer optimized token usage to better serve customers. Leave with a practical framework for balancing quality, cost, and latency in production AI.

sessions.title: Trust at scale: Governance lessons from Microsoft
sessions.desc: As Microsoft deploys AI across products used by hundreds of millions of people, trust has become an operational imperative. In this session, Sarah Bird, Microsoft's Chief Product Officer for Responsible AI, shares how Microsoft approaches AI governance, safety, security, and compliance across its own AI systems. Learn practical lessons in risk-based governance, embedded guardrails, continuous monitoring, and scalable controls that enable trusted AI at scale.

sessions.title: From traces to better agents: The Foundry improvement loop
sessions.desc: Building an agent is the start. Improving it in production is the real work. See how Microsoft Foundry connects traces, evaluations, and optimization to help teams find high-impact issues, test improvements, and re-measure results. Learn a repeatable loop to improve quality, manage cost, and ship better agents while developers stay in control.

sessions.title: Govern AI everywhere: From open frameworks to enterprise control
sessions.desc: Your teams already picked their tools, and telling them to start over is how an AI program loses a year. This session shows the alternative. Start with open source that runs against agents built in any framework, then bring those same agents into Microsoft Foundry when you need enterprise identity, policy, and one view of quality across the estate. Leave knowing what you get for free, what requires a platform, and where lock-in risk actually sits.

sessions.title: Agents in production: Three failures, three fixes
sessions.desc: Most enterprises can build an agent. The harder question is knowing whether it is getting better in production. Explore three real failure patterns, then see how Microsoft Foundry brings together tracing, evaluations, insights and optimization to surface issues, understand what happened, and improve quality, reliability, and cost on a repeatable cadence.

sessions.title: Post-train your model and fine tune in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.desc: Frontier models are available to everyone, your advantage is how you customize them. Learn how Microsoft Foundry turns production data and agent traces into smaller, faster, task-optimized models. Learn what's new with Foundry Fine-tuning and Training , and join Paypal and Motif to hear how they leveraged open models via Fireworks on Foundry and fine-tuned them to deliver production outcomes.

sessions.title: Operate AI at enterprise scale with Microsoft Foundry
sessions.desc: AI adoption is expanding to fleets of agents, making governance an operational challenge. Explore how AI Gateway, Responsible AI controls, agent identity, FinOps, and governance integrations provide visibility and control across your AI estate. Microsoft Foundry provides the governance foundation for AI systems, integrating with Agent 365 for enterprise operations and administration. Leave with a practical framework for running AI securely from development to production.

sessions.title: Turn enterprise data in a durable advantage with Microsoft AI models
sessions.desc: AI agents and apps are only as good as the data and models behind them. Get a first look at the latest MAI model innovations for reasoning, coding, voice, image, and multimodal work, built on a clean, traceable data lineage and already powering Microsoft 365 Copilot, PowerPoint, Excel, OneDrive, GitHub, and Bing. Then see how Frontier Tuning closes the loop, using your data, workflows, and evaluation criteria to continuously optimize models and agents in Microsoft Foundry.

sessions.title: Build private, responsive on-device AI agents with Foundry
sessions.desc: Bring AI closer to users, data, and decisions. This session shows developers how to build responsive, private, and resilient AI applications and agents on-device  — running across Windows, macOS, Linux, and emerging mobile scenarios, without requiring a cloud connection for every inference.

sessions.title: What's next for physical AI models and how to build with them
sessions.desc: Physical AI is transforming industries from manufacturing and logistics to autonomous systems and industrial automation. Join this deep dive into the state of physical AI and discover how world foundation models, synthetic data generation, reasoning, post-training, and simulation work together to build smarter physical AI systems.

sessions.title: Inside Microsoft: How we scale expertise with Foundry agents
sessions.desc: Facing hundreds of blog posts a year, only a couple of expert reviewers, and a rapidly accelerating pace of business, Microsoft's Foundry marketing team turned its own review standard into a rubric and built a Foundry agent to apply it. Feedback that took two weeks now arrives in minutes, and the team can focus on what matters: building messaging that resonates. What the team automated is consistency and quality, not judgment.

sessions.title: Agentic automation: How Copilot Studio blends workflows and agents
sessions.desc: Deterministic and non-deterministic thinking are the core of why Copilot Studio enables mixing Workflows and Agents. See how we're taking this to the next level with new workflow authoring experiences, integration with agents, and enhanced reliability.

sessions.title: Understand Copilot Studio's GitHub Copilot harness: Behind the scenes
sessions.desc: Go behind the build of the new GitHub Copilot harness in Copilot Studio and see how it powers complex, long-running agents. Learn how the harness orchestrates models, context, tools, and agent collaboration to plan, adapt, and execute business processes. Discover how this architecture helps organizations create agents that are more capable, reliable, reusable, and secure, while providing a durable foundation that evolves with AI models and business needs.

sessions.title: The next evolution of AI FinOps: From cost to value
sessions.desc: Visibility into AI spend is just the beginning. Learn how leading organizations optimize investments across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and GitHub Copilot to maximize business impact. Discover how new capabilities, including AI Flex Spend, help you manage costs, prove value, and scale the AI initiatives that deliver the biggest results.

sessions.title: Build intelligent autopilots for recurring business processes
sessions.desc: Learn how to build Copilot Studio agents that behave like autopilots for recurring business processes. See how agent accounts, triggers, business process memory, and agent improvement recommendations help agents work with their own identity, act proactively, retain process context, and continuously improve to facilitate recurring business processes - while the users in control.
speakers: Director of Product, Copilot Studio, Agent Capabilities

sessions.title: Scale agents, not risk: Governance and FinOps for the enterprise
sessions.desc: As agents move from experimentation to enterprise-wide deployment, IT needs a new approach to governance and FinOps. Learn how to build a scalable operating model across agent inventory, lifecycle, security, cost management, and optimization, giving teams the freedom to innovate while maintaining the visibility, guardrails, and financial discipline IT needs.

sessions.title: Master AI spend management with Agent 365: Govern your AI budget
sessions.desc: See the tools IT needs to govern, control, and optimize AI spend at scale. Join this deep dive into Agent 365 and Microsoft 365 Admin Center capabilities for AI FinOps. Learn how to establish guardrails with policies, monitor consumption across AI vendors, measure value, and confidently scale AI across your organization. This is the essential session for IT to understand the latest innovations in AI cost management and governance.

sessions.title: Pick the right harness to build your agents with using Copilot Studio
sessions.desc: When should you not build using the GitHub Copilot harness in Copilot Studio? Come learn about how factors like the business process, its complexity, user experience, and cost influence which harness you would want to build your agent with. Leave the session knowing how to match the right harness to the job, while building agents that are fit for their intended purpose.

sessions.title: Apps and agents: Business process transformation in Copilot Studio
sessions.desc: Discover how Copilot Studio brings apps and agents together on one governed platform for business transformation. Learn how apps provide structured experiences while agents reason and act across systems to transofrm end to end business processes. Come and see how makers and developers can build with natural language, connect enterprise data and actions, and move solutions from idea to production with shared security, governance, and lifecycle management.

sessions.title: Maximize your Copilot ROI: Scale AI with flexibility and control
sessions.desc: AI investments are growing. Expectations for business value are growing even faster. Learn how Microsoft 365 Copilot helps organizations maximize return on AI investments through built in value optimization, cost transparency, and flexible spending options. Discover how leaders can measure outcomes, allocate spend across Copilot and other AI solutions, and continuously optimize investments to drive meaningful business results.

sessions.title: What's new in Copilot Studio
sessions.desc: A keynote-style talk on the biggest recent Copilot Studio features, including the newly upgraded all-in-one platform to build apps, workflows, and agents as well as exciting updates coming in the near future.

sessions.title: Build as a team with GitHub Copilot tailored to your workflow
sessions.desc: Help your team ship faster without giving up the checks you rely on. See how GitHub Copilot can follow your team’s instructions, connect to your tools, and take on tasks as part of your everyday development process. Walk through how testing, code review, and your organization’s policies help keep people in control as agents do more of the work. Leave with a practical approach to making Copilot useful across your team, not just for individual developers.

sessions.title: Ship more software with parallel agents in the GitHub Copilot app
sessions.desc: Build a new feature while agents investigate issues, add tests, and prepare other changes for review. In this demo-led session, follow an idea from prompt to merged pull request in the GitHub Copilot app. See how to choose models for different tasks, hand off work to Autopilot, and turn repeatable tasks into automations. Keep track of what's running, step in where needed, and validate the results, so you can take on more without losing control of what ships.

sessions.title: Manage GitHub Copilot spending and understand team adoption
sessions.desc: Make informed decisions about your Copilot investment. Explore how model choices, agent workflows, and GitHub Actions contribute to development costs, then use billing reports, budgets, and alerts to manage spending. Learn to interpret adoption and engagement trends, spot underused capabilities, and target support where teams need it. IT admins and engineering leaders will leave with practical steps to manage costs and help developers use Copilot effectively.

sessions.title: Roll out GitHub Copilot with the right IT controls
sessions.desc: Scaling GitHub Copilot agents is not just a developer decision. It raises new questions about identity, access, data protection, policy, auditability, cost, support, and lifecycle management. Built for IT leaders, admins, and platform teams, this session uses live demos to show where GitHub provides control, where human oversight still matters, and what your organization should decide before expanding access.

sessions.title: Bring GitHub Copilot where you work
sessions.desc: You build software across more than one tool, and GitHub Copilot can meet you in each of them. See how Copilot supports the full development lifecycle across IDEs, the terminal, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and mobile devices. Follow work from planning and building through review, security, and release, choosing from multiple AI models along the way. Understand how Copilot connects these experiences to improve developer flow and help organizations deliver better software faster.

sessions.title: Hand off the task or take the keyboard in VS Code
sessions.desc: AI coding should not make you choose between delegating the work and staying close to the code. Follow a real task through GitHub Copilot in VS Code, from handing it off in the agents window to reviewing, editing, and debugging in the editor. See how familiar Claude and Codex workflows carry over while your files, terminal, extensions, and project context stay within reach. You will leave with a practical understanding of when to use each experience and how they work together.

sessions.title: What should you build when you can build anything?
sessions.desc: What do you build when the answer is “anything”? We'll take you on a fast, fun tour of Windows, GitHub, OSS and all the fun new shiny things. Expect big ideas, surprises, and a parade of demos showing what happens when powerful tools meet relentless curiosity. Come for the awesome. Leave with new possibilities and an urge to build something.

sessions.title: Unlock more value from your business apps with GitHub Copilot SDK
sessions.desc: Your app estate holds the processes and expertise that run your business, but too much work requires people to navigate systems step by step. Explore use cases showing how agentic applications automate work, accelerate decisions, and extend investments across the applications employees rely on every day. Learn where agents deliver measurable value and how the GitHub Copilot SDK’s agentic harness provides a path to production while preserving your security, governance, controls, and integrations.

sessions.title: Hack the harness: Customize and secure GitHub Copilot SDK agents
sessions.desc: In this session, we'll open up the GitHub Copilot SDK harness and trace how context, tools, models, and execution fit together. Learn to add custom tools and MCP servers, intercept prompts and tool calls with hooks, and scope specialized agents to the context and permissions they need. See where Microsoft Entra, Purview, and Defender apply identity, data, and threat controls throughout the harness. You’ll leave with starter templates and the confidence to begin testing your own ideas safely.

sessions.title: What’s new in the GitHub Copilot runtime: Models, hosts, and sessions
sessions.desc: GitHub Copilot is becoming a shared agent runtime across developer tools. See how the harness can route work to the right model for each task and execution environment, coordinate local and cloud execution, and more!

sessions.title: Building a model for software development from the ground up
sessions.desc: Benchmarks alone can’t predict how a model will perform in a real product. Follow Microsoft AI’s journey building a model for coding and agentic software development, with GitHub Copilot as its proving ground. Explore how model design, training, real-world workflows, and product signals shape iteration across quality, latency, cost, and control—and leave with practical lessons for building specialized production models.

sessions.title: Designing an agent harness that orchestrates models
sessions.desc: Choosing a model is becoming less important than deciding how and when models are used. Explore how routing can match models to different tasks, constraints, and stages of development. We’ll examine the signals and tradeoffs that guide these decisions, and approaches such as HydraFusion that coordinate models as a portfolio. Leave with a framework for building adaptable agent systems across quality, latency, cost, and control.

sessions.title: Securing coding agents and their code
sessions.desc: Coding agents can write code in minutes. Security teams need confidence that both the agent and its output can be trusted. Learn how GitHub helps organizations secure agent-driven development with isolated sandboxes, protections against supply chain threats, and automated validation of AI-generated code before deployment. Discover how to scale the use of coding agents while maintaining security and governance across the development lifecycle.

sessions.title: Detect, fix, and govern code and credential risk with AI
sessions.desc: With agentic development, developers are shipping faster than ever, while attackers are rapidly shrinking the window from public disclosure to exploitation. Security teams can't review every change, and headcount won't scale. See how GitHub Advanced Security uses AI to extend your reach: scanning surfaces multi-step exploits, secret scanning with push protection stops leaked credentials, and Agentic Autofix delivers fixes as ready-to-merge PRs.

sessions.title: The backlog problem gets worse with AI. Here's how to fix it.
sessions.desc: Getting ready for AI means getting ahead of security debt. As development accelerates, security teams need a better way to prioritize risk than severity scores alone. Learn how organizations identify the vulnerabilities, dependencies, and secrets most likely to matter, then drive remediation at scale through security campaigns and agentic autofix that help teams reduce backlogs and focus on what needs fixing.

sessions.title: What’s new in Azure AI Landing Zones
sessions.desc: In this session, you’ll learn an end-to-end approach to developing AI apps and agents on Foundry that are production-ready from day one. Leverage AI Landing Zones as the reference architecture with extensible implementation for Foundry to accelerate infrastructure deployment, then develop an agentic RAG application on top of it. Learn how to leverage Foundry models, agent service, IQ, tools and control place at enterprise scale for deploying and developing AI Apps & Agents in production.

sessions.title: From AI experiments to autonomous agents at Hyperscale
sessions.desc: We will show how Microsoft moved from experiments to autonomous resolution for complex Azure support scenarios, and how the same patterns can support industry use-case discovery and solution design. See how Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and Learn MCP connect data, decisions, and actions, with GitHub Copilot supporting development. We will share the reusable harness, evaluations, hill climbing, guardrails, and AIOps practices needed to operate agents safely at scale.

sessions.title: Secure the CI pipeline: Practical defenses for GitHub Actions
sessions.desc: GitHub Actions workflows can access credentials, networks, and production systems, making them high-value software supply chain targets. Using an attack-path map and before-and-after demos, we'll show how to defend against pull_request_target misuse, floating action refs, cache poisoning, over-permissioned credentials, widened trust boundaries, and open egress. You'll leave able to audit workflows, pin and scope what runs, contain blast radius, and expose malicious behavior.

sessions.title: Trusted code at scale, from legacy to AI
sessions.desc: Every codebase carries quality debt, and AI adds to it faster than teams can pay down. Performance issues inflate cloud cost, maintainability debt slows every future change, and reliability gaps surface as incidents. GitHub Code Quality catches these across new and existing code where developers work, recommends fixes, and gives engineering leaders governance to enforce standards. Agentic autofix then remediates findings at scale, turning backlogs into reviewable pull requests.

sessions.title: Visual Studio fleet governance for the agentic era
sessions.desc: AI is changing how developers build software. Learn how IT administrators can enable AI across their organization while maintaining security and compliance. See how Visual Studio supports Copilot and BYOK policies, private extension marketplace, allow and deny controls for extensions, and centralized management, empowering every developer to use AI securely and productively at scale.

sessions.title: GitHub, the agent native engineering system
sessions.desc: AI agents are reshaping engineering beyond code generation. Discover how GitHub provides an agent-native system where humans and agents collaborate across defining, delivering, and assessing software. Learn how integrated governance, shared knowledge, and continuous feedback help organizations safely scale agentic development—accelerating delivery while maintaining quality and focus on customer value.

sessions.title: Unified governance for developers and AI agents with GitHub Enterprise
sessions.desc: As AI agents become active participants in software delivery, enterprises need governance that spans both people and agents. Learn how GitHub Enterprise provides unified identity, access, policy, audit, and lifecycle controls—while enabling IT administrators to use Copilot to simplify administration, investigate activity, and safely scale AI adoption.

sessions.title: The intelligence layer for the self-improving SDLC
sessions.desc: What if engineering systems could learn from what teams have already solved? The GitHub platform holds knowledge across code, pull requests, reviews, and AI agent activity. Bringing these signals together can reveal what's happening, why, and what should change next. We'll show how patterns across teams can identify affected repos, shape a shared plan, and guide coding agents under human review—with real results from Microsoft and customers showing how organizations can learn and act at scale.

sessions.title: Getting the most out of GitHub Copilot and Azure DevOps
sessions.desc: Azure DevOps customers can use GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows whether their repositories are hosted in Azure Repos or GitHub. In this session, we will demonstrate Copilot code review for Azure Repos and show how to use the Azure DevOps MCP Server with Visual Studio Code, GitHub CLI, and GitHub Copilot app. We will also cover how to use Auto fix with GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps.

sessions.title: Build your IQ using your unique enterprise context with Microsoft IQ
sessions.desc: Unveiling new features in Microsoft IQ to enable enterprises users to equip agents with the context they need to succeed. See how teams can curate data that bring together knowledge, data, tools, and skills, then publish them for agents across the enterprise. Learn how a shared, governed context can accelerate agent development, improve consistency, and help every agent understand how your organization works.

sessions.title: Building interactive app experiences powered by Microsoft IQ
sessions.desc: See how Microsoft IQ brings together an end-to-end agent platform to power a new generation of intelligent app experiences. Microsoft IQ provides the business context and knowledge, while Fabric and Foundry enable users and AI agents to build secure, enterprise-ready applications on top of that intelligence. Discover how to turn insights into action, workflows, and applications without leaving the flow of work.

sessions.title: Web IQ: The new search engine for agents
sessions.desc: Web search was designed for people: type, scroll, click. But agents need structured data and act in milliseconds. This session explores how modern search, designed for agents, drives business outcomes. Learn how Web IQ adds value to AI systems with fresh information and world context, including news, data feeds, images, videos, commerce and more. See why the agentic web demands a new retrieval architecture, and what you can build on Web IQ today.

sessions.title: Work IQ governance and trust: Control the intelligence layer
sessions.desc: Trust is the foundation of enterprise AI. Explore the governance controls that help administrators secure and scale Work IQ across apps and agents. Learn how to manage data access, apply policy controls, monitor consumption, and optimize costs so teams can innovate with confidence while maintaining security, compliance, and oversight.

sessions.title: The shift from RAG to context: Grounding agents with Foundry IQ
sessions.desc: The market is moving from app-specific RAG to shared context layers to give many agents secure access to trusted enterprise knowledge. We'll explore how Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) improves grounding across the stack: from core search innovations and knowledge graphs to purpose-built models that make agentic retrieval faster, higher quality, and easier to configure. We'll also show how Foundry IQ fits into Microsoft IQ, enabling people and agents with easier knowledge discovery and consumption.

sessions.title: Bringing conversational analytics to where decisions happen
sessions.desc: Data should meet users where decisions happen. Learn how Microsoft Fabric brings conversational analytics into the tools people use every day. Powered by Fabric IQ, which unifies OneLake, the Power BI semantic layer, ontologies, and data agents, Fabric provides a trusted intelligence layer for copilots, applications, and workflows. See how organizations connect analytics, context, AI, and governance to turn questions into actions.

sessions.title: Give agents and people the business context to act with Work IQ
sessions.desc: See how Business Apps in Work IQ brings together CRM, ERP, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and more to create a real-time view of your end-to-end business processes. Discover how connected business context helps agents and employees make better decisions, take action faster, and work more effectively across the organization.
speakers: Director of Product Management, Microsoft Dataverse and Work IQ

sessions.title: Building agentic retrieval: From DIY to Foundry IQ
sessions.desc: Why does agentic retrieval matter, and what does it take to build it yourself? In this session, we will first code an agent loop that decomposes a question, runs parallel searches, inspects evidence, and decides whether to search again. Then we'll see how Foundry IQ can replace that plumbing with a managed agentic knowledge base. Learn how we made the managed service cheaper, faster, and better, thanks to serverless execution, compression, fine-tuned task-specific models, and built-in ranking.

sessions.title: Building context-aware agents with Microsoft IQ
sessions.desc: What if your agents could reason with the full intelligence of your organization? Learn how Microsoft IQ grounds agents in your company’s unique data, knowledge, work, and business context across Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, and Web IQ. Discover how your IQ helps agents take more relevant actions, enable trusted decisions, and accelerate business outcomes.
speakers: VP Products and AI Futurist, CoreAI

sessions.title: Build personalized AI experiences with Work IQ
sessions.desc: See how information workers and developers use Work IQ to power intelligent experiences across declarative agents, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and third-party platforms. Learn how Work IQ combines organizational context with connectors, agent-to-agent experiences, and external systems to create secure, personalized solutions grounded in your organization's knowledge, processes, and permissions.

sessions.title: Secure your business presence in the AI web with Web IQ
sessions.desc: Your next customer may never visit your website. AI assistants and agents increasingly research products, evaluate vendors, and influence buying decisions. Learn how WebIQ powers AI discovery, why some brands get recommended while others are overlooked, and what you can do to improve visibility and trust. Leave with a practical playbook to help your business get found, recommended, and chosen in the AI web.

sessions.title: What's new in Work IQ
sessions.desc: Discover the latest innovations in Work IQ. Learn how Work IQ is expanding organizational intelligence through richer context across M365 data such as emails and chats, advanced retrieval and grounding experiences, and unified intelligence endpoints. Get an inside look at new capabilities, integration patterns, and the vision for powering smarter agents and personalized AI across the Microsoft ecosystem.

sessions.title: Designing Fabric IQ for enterprise adoption
sessions.desc: Moving from a Fabric IQ demo to enterprise adoption requires more than building an ontology. Learn a practical design approach for selecting a high-value business scenario, grounding shared business context in governed Fabric data, defining ownership and access, integrating analytics and agents, and planning an incremental rollout. Leave with a reusable framework for aligning architecture, governance, user experience, and adoption measures as Fabric IQ reaches general availability.

sessions.title: Fabric IQ: Trusted business context for enterprise AI
sessions.desc: Enterprise AI is only as effective as the business context behind it. Discover how Microsoft IQ unifies knowledge across the Microsoft ecosystem and how Fabric IQ provides trusted business meaning that helps AI understand how an organization operates. Learn how enterprises can reuse existing data and knowledge to deliver consistent answers, make informed decisions, and enable agents to act with confidence.

sessions.title: Foundry IQ: Better enterprise context for agents
sessions.desc: Agents can only reason over what they can retrieve. Fact lookups are easy, but many enterprise questions depend on themes, trends, and connections across a whole corpus. See how Foundry IQ knowledge bases and agentic retrieval give agents richer enterprise context, with live demos and before-and-after quality results.

sessions.title: How Microsoft IQ shapes the cost of enterprise AI
sessions.desc: Enterprise AI does not have one cost model. It has three: people, consumption, and capacity. Through a retail AI scenario and a live cost estimation demo, this session shows how Work IQ, Foundry IQ,  Fabric IQ, and Web IQ create different cost shapes, and how to optimize each one for scale, value, and control.

sessions.title: Optimizing AI agents to meet your goals: Grounding with Web IQ
sessions.desc: Every grounding call is a trade-off. The highest-quality answer isn’t always the right one — sometimes your agent needs speed, sometimes freshness, sometimes precision at any cost. This session breaks down the quality-latency-cost frontier behind agent retrieval with Web IQ: when to let auto routing decide, when to orchestrate yourself, and how to design grounding strategies that hold up in production. Leave with a decision framework for any agent you’re building.

sessions.title: The evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ
sessions.desc: Better context leads to better AI applications, but improvement requires more than trial and error. In this session, we'll build an evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ applications, using evaluations to compare retrieval configurations, context strategies, prompts, and models. Learn how to identify weak spots, measure the impact of changes, and systematically improve application quality. See how evaluations can transform context engineering from guesswork into an iterative, data-driven practice.

sessions.title: Web IQ in action: How enterprises build grounded, governed AI agents
sessions.desc: Join Microsoft and a customer to explore how Web IQ enables enterprise-grade AI agents grounded in the public web. Through a real-world customer experience, learn how Web IQ supports high-value business scenarios while meeting enterprise requirements for security, governance, quality, and scale. Hear directly from the customer about the business need, implementation journey, key learnings, and outcomes achieved with Web IQ.

sessions.title: The trust and governance foundation for the age of AI agents
sessions.desc: AI is entering a new era where agents reason, collaborate, and take action across business systems. As intelligence becomes more autonomous, trust becomes the critical infrastructure that enables innovation to scale. Join Sarah and Mohammad to explore Microsoft's vision for governing the next generation of AI: from policy and oversight to security, transparency, and human accountability. Learn how organizations can confidently unlock the promise of AI agents while staying in control.

sessions.title: Agentic incident management: Lessons from production AIOps
sessions.desc: Explore how agentic orchestration can transform incident management in production AIOps. This session examines how AI agents coordinate investigations, connect operational signals, and support human decisions. Discover practical design patterns, implementation challenges, and lessons for building reliable, responsible workflows that help teams respond to incidents more effectively.

sessions.title: Winning the Race Against Time with Autonomous Protection
sessions.desc: AI is changing the economics of cyberattacks, compressing the gap between discovery and exploitation. Learn how Microsoft is rethinking autonomous protection for an era where exposure evolves faster than traditional defenses can keep pace.
speakers: Vice President Engineering, Agentic Security, Microsoft Security

sessions.title: What the Frontlines Reveal About Modern Security
sessions.desc: What threats and challenges are Microsoft experts seeing on the frontlines of cyber defense? Hear directly from frontline experts and explore practical guidance for making threat intelligence actionable, operationalizing AI agents, and building cyber resilience.

sessions.title: Project Perception: How Agentic Security Works
sessions.desc: Stay ahead of evolving threats with Project Perception, Microsoft’s new agentic security system. See how specialized red, blue, and green team agents work together with shared security context to expose weaknesses, investigate threats, prioritize risk, and strengthen defenses. Learn how coordinated multi-agent defense helps your team move from reactive security to continuous protection, while keeping people in control of critical decisions.

sessions.title: Find and fix code vulnerabilities faster with Codename MDASH
sessions.desc: Accelerate vulnerability discovery with multi-model agentic security. Codename MDASH orchestrates specialized AI agents and security-focused AI models to identify, validate, and prioritize vulnerabilities, helping teams understand risk and focus on the issues that matter most.

sessions.title: The Agentic SOC Reality: Market Hype vs. AI Models vs. Automation
sessions.desc: Explore the real-time architectural breakdown of what happens when agentic AI hits production IT environments. Together, Forrester principal analyst Allie Mellen and two Microsoft executives will tear down a modern SOC architecture live on stage—mapping out where agents safely automate outcomes, where non-deterministic AI breaks IT change controls, and how to design guardrails that CISOs and IT Directors can actually trust.
speakers: Vice President Engineering, Agentic Security, Microsoft Security

sessions.title: Threat Intelligence reimagined: From signals to protection at AI speed
sessions.desc: Go beyond static threat intelligence feeds. See how Microsoft combines industry-leading visibility, expert-led research, and AI automation to turn intelligence into action. Explore demos and practical strategies to defend against today’s top threats.

sessions.title: Stay ahead of endpoint risk with AI-powered discovery and remediation
sessions.desc: Outpace endpoint risk with AI-powered insight and governed remediation. See how Microsoft helps IT and security prioritize exposure, apply patches or mitigations, stage change safely, and verify risk reduction without disrupting work.
speakers: Product Lead, AI Experiences for Microsoft Security

sessions.title: Project Perception Roadmap: New Capabilities, Use Cases & What's Next
sessions.desc: How must security operations evolve when AI can act? Explore Microsoft’s agentic security vision and roadmap and learn how people, AI agents, and trusted controls can work together to accelerate defense across the security lifecycle.
speakers: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Microsoft Security

sessions.title: The Alert Is Dead. The Blueprint for the Agentic SOC
sessions.desc: What replaces alert-centric operations? In this session, we'll map the blueprint of the Agentic SOC and show how the integrated security operations center (ISOC) provides the foundation for outcome-driven defense. Learn how leading teams are shifting from triage to continuous attack disruption, how humans and AI divide responsibilities, and the architectural changes required to unify protection, operations, and AI into a single security system.

sessions.title: From Copilot to Perception: The Journey to Agentic Security
sessions.desc: Agentic security goes beyond task assistance; it's a new working model for your team. Learn from the experts how to implement agentic security effectively, and what are the trust, governance, and readiness benchmarks you need in place. We’ll provide a checklist of capabilities and architectural requirements, and explore lessons learned from Perception customers on achieving scalable autonomous defense.

sessions.title: Build secure foundations to scale AI across your organization
sessions.desc: Zero Trust principles are the design; secure foundations are the build. Walk the four evidence-based controls across identity, devices, endpoints and email, see the attack paths each closes, and scale AI across your organization.

sessions.title: See and reduce exposure across your digital estate
sessions.desc: Your teams are drowning in findings while attackers need one path. See the new Microsoft Security Exposure Management experience map frontline threat intelligence to your exposures, validate what's real, and produce an agent-assisted, risk-ranked plan of action.

sessions.title: Build a trusted device and app foundation for AI at scale
sessions.desc: Devices and apps are where AI meets the real world. See how to govern configuration across your estate, deploy change confidently, prevent drift, verify success and recover fast, so endpoint risk stops undermining your AI foundations.

sessions.title: Get your data AI-ready: Discover & mitigate data exposure risks
sessions.desc: As AI accelerates access to information, organizations need stronger protections for sensitive data. Learn how Microsoft Purview combines classification, permissions insights, and controls to reduce oversharing and secure data across AI.

sessions.title: Protect applications across code, cloud, and runtime
sessions.desc: Modern applications span cloud resources, identities, data, containers, and networks. Learn how Microsoft Defender and Azure Firewall and DDoS protection help uncover attack paths, detect runtime threats, and respond to multi-stage attacks.

sessions.title: A Single Policy for Humans and AI Agents? Here’s How to Make It Work
sessions.desc: Dozens of policies become hundreds, and changing one can break something downstream. See how a unified policy engine brings identity, network, device, and risk signals together to make access decisions without forcing teams to untangle dependencies. Learn how to scale adaptive access with confidence and control.​

sessions.title: Identity Knows What Your SOC Doesn’t: Stop Threats Faster Together
sessions.desc: Identity attacks move fast. Your teams need to move faster. See how Microsoft Entra brings identity context into SOC investigations so IAM and security teams can detect, investigate, and stop threats with visibility, risk signals, and automation.

sessions.title: From threat intelligence to protection across your estate
sessions.desc: See how Defender Security Research turns real-world attacks into coordinated protection. Learn how the unified security graph connects signals and threat intelligence to power detection, prevention, attack disruption and built-in agents.

sessions.title: Modern Phishing Doesn't End at the Click
sessions.desc: Attackers don't need to steal your password to compromise your identity or account. See how AI-powered phishing, impersonation, compromised accounts, and identity-based attacks are changing the game, and how identity, email and collaboration security help defenders detect and disrupt threats before they spread.

sessions.title: Insights from Microsoft's journey to prepare its data for AI adoption
sessions.desc: Before deploying Copilot broadly, Microsoft focused on the fundamentals: understanding sensitive data, managing access, reducing oversharing, and establishing governance. Learn the strategies and lessons from our AI readiness journey.

sessions.title: When AI acts, security has to answer: Microsoft Security for AI
sessions.desc: Learn how to accelerate AI innovation with confidence by securing AI across its lifecycle. Discover how to protect apps and agents, govern AI access and data, enforce network controls, gain visibility into AI risk, and contain threats through a unified security approach.

sessions.title: Stay ahead of evolving AI agent risks
sessions.desc: AI agents can introduce new and evolving security risks as they gain access to data, tools, and enterprise resources. Learn how Microsoft helps security teams understand changing agent risk, investigate potential issues, and strengthen protection across the AI agent ecosystem.

sessions.title: Secure data as you scale your agents with Microsoft Purview and A365
sessions.desc: AI agents can access data and automate work at unprecedented scale. Learn how Microsoft Purview helps discover agent activity, protect sensitive information, detect risk and meet compliance requirements for a growing landscape of AI agents.

sessions.title: Local agents are here. Can you find and secure them?
sessions.desc: Local agents can unlock major productivity, but unmanaged adoption introduces risk leaders cannot ignore. Learn how to close the visibility gap, reduce risk, and enable trusted agent adoption without slowing innovation.
speakers: Director, Product Marketing - Identity & Network Access

sessions.title: A Zero Trust approach to securing AI runtime with Microsoft Defender
sessions.desc: AI agents are the next attack surface. Learn how Microsoft Defender helps apply Zero Trust, reduce agent risk, and defend against AI attacks such as prompt injection, tool misuse, and identity abuse, with guidance mapped to OWASP and MITRE.

sessions.title: Inside Look at Agent 365: Lessons from Microsoft's Office of the CISO
sessions.desc: As organizations deploy more AI agents, security teams face new visibility, risk, and governance challenges. Join us to hear best practices and lessons learned from Microsoft's Office of the CISO on how to use Agent 365 for a growing agentic estate. Drawing on Microsoft’s experience, you’ll gain actionable guidance to strengthen AI security and governance while accelerating innovation responsibly.

sessions.title: Secure data and manage AI risk for Microsoft Copilot and Cowork
sessions.desc: Confidently deploy and scale Microsoft Copilot and Cowork. Explore how Microsoft Purview helps you understand and protect sensitive data, reduce oversharing risk, govern permissions and investigate incidents, to secure your AI-powered workplace.

sessions.title: AI is changing access. See how Microsoft Entra helps you stay ahead.
sessions.desc: Get the identity and network access roadmap to help your organization get ready for AI, scale AI responsibly with Agent 365, and leverage AI to detect and disrupt attacks. See what's new in securing access for people and agents, reducing risk, and enabling productivity without weakening protection. This team delivers top-ranked standing-room-only sessions every year, so don't miss it!
speakers: Chief Technology Officer, Americas Markets and Industries

sessions.title: Build secure, stay secure: Protecting AI from code to runtime
sessions.desc: Learn how to build secure, enterprise-ready AI agents without slowing developer productivity. We'll explore how to secure agents by design, use Agent 365 to govern and secure them at enterprise scale, and protect them in production. Bring consistent security and governance across a heterogenous environment of agents, platforms, and ecosystems. Discover an end-to-end approach to protecting AI from development through runtime.

sessions.title: Master Agent Governance with Agent 365
sessions.desc: AI agents are multiplying across organizations. Without the right governance foundation, it becomes difficult to know which agents exist, who owns them, what they can access, and whether they're operating as intended. Learn how Agent 365 helps organizations govern AI agents at scale with centralized oversight, accountability, policy and tools management, and lifecycle governance. Through practical examples and demos, learn how to confidently manage, govern, and secure a growing agent ecosystem.

sessions.title: Strengthen Data Security and Compliance for the AI Era with Purview
sessions.desc: Learn how Microsoft Purview provides unified data security and compliance to help you identify risk, protect sensitive data across Microsoft 365 and Copilot, and accelerate investigations — so you can scale AI securely and confidently.

sessions.title: Strengthen and Manage Data Security Posture with Microsoft Purview
sessions.desc: AI readiness starts with data visibility. Learn how Microsoft Purview helps you strengthen your data security posture through insights into permissions, oversharing risks, remediation and controls, enabling you to safely deploy Copilot at scale.

sessions.title: Microsoft Purview: Build the Trusted Data Foundation for AI
sessions.desc: Secure AI starts with understanding your data. Discover how Microsoft Purview uses AI-powered classification and sensitivity labels to identify sensitive content, automate protection, and help organizations confidently scale Copilot adoption.

sessions.title: Building high-performance analytics with Fabric Data Warehouse
sessions.desc: Modern organizations need a platform that unifies their data estate, scales with growing business demands, powers AI-driven experiences, and delivers fast, predictable analytics. In this session, explore how Fabric Data Warehouse helps organizations modernize their analytics architecture with an open, SaaS-first approach built on OneLake. We'll showcase the latest innovations, including GPU acceleration capabilities and integrated experiences for analytics and AI.

sessions.title: Unify your data estate with Microsoft OneLake
sessions.desc: Microsoft OneLake is designed to unify your entire multi‑cloud data estate on a single data lake. In this session, we'll cover the latest investments across data storage, governance, discovery, and domain-oriented data, and share what's next as we continue to simplify data management, strengthen governance, and prepare data for the next generation of AI experiences.

sessions.title: Building, deploying, and governing Microsoft Fabric at scale
sessions.desc: Managing data and AI at scale requires a platform that balances agility with control. In this session, we'll explore the latest investments across development workflows, automation, observability, governance, security, and cost management. Learn how organizations can build, deploy, and operate modern data and AI solutions while maintaining reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.

sessions.title: AI-ready data integration with Fabric Data Factory
sessions.desc: See how Fabric Data Factory helps teams connect, transform, govern, and operationalize enterprise data for AI. Learn patterns for pipelines, Dataflows, Copy Jobs, Mirroring, OneLake integrations, data quality, and analytics engineering with dbt to deliver trusted data for copilots, agents, and analytics. Additionally, learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory workloads to Microsoft Fabric.

sessions.title: Migrate to Microsoft Fabric: Modernize your data estate
sessions.desc: Learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse workloads to Microsoft Fabric. This session covers migration strategy, workload assessment, pipeline and dataflow modernization, warehouse and lakehouse patterns, CI/CD, governance, customer case studies and  operational best practices to reduce risk and accelerate analytics and AI on Fabric.

sessions.title: Build like a startup. Deploy like an enterprise.
sessions.desc: Microsoft Copilot is evolving into a platform where apps are built, shared, and run. See how Rayfin enables anyone to create intelligent applications powered by Fabric data, Work IQ, enterprise APIs, and AI models directly within Copilot. Learn how Rayfin provides the runtime, connectivity, governance, and deployment capabilities needed to move from a simple prompt to a production-ready application. Discover how you can use Copilot to build the next generation of business solutions

sessions.title: Agentic development with Fabric Copilot
sessions.desc: Fabric Copilot is the AI-powered front door to agentic development in Microsoft Fabric. Learn how Fabric IQ, data, analytics, databases, and apps come together to help teams design, build, and operate intelligent solutions using natural language. See how new capabilities orchestrate work across specialized agents, accelerate application development, and connect organizational knowledge with governed data, enabling developers and business users to move from ideas to intelligent apps faster.

sessions.title: Fabric Real-Time Intelligence: From signal to action
sessions.desc: Discover how Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence turns data in motion into insight and action. Explore the latest innovations for detecting critical signals, analyzing events as they happen, and enabling people and AI agents to respond faster and make smarter decisions.

sessions.title: Get more Spark for less with Microsoft Fabric
sessions.desc: Get more from every dollar with Microsoft Fabric. See how Fabric combines Spark with native optimizations, intelligent workload management, and flexible consumption options to deliver industry-leading price performance. Learn how customers can process data faster, reduce infrastructure costs, and scale analytics efficiently. We’ll walk through benchmarks, real-world scenarios, and practical strategies for maximizing performance and value from Spark in Fabric.

sessions.title: Build intelligent PostgreSQL apps with HorizonDB in Microsoft Fabric
sessions.desc: Discover HorizonDB in Microsoft Fabric, a Fabric-native PostgreSQL experience that helps developers build operational applications on a unified platform for transactions, analytics, and AI. Learn how HorizonDB enables applications to query operational and analytical data through a single PostgreSQL experience, reducing data movement and ETL complexity while delivering real-time insights. Build AI-ready applications faster with built-in governance and seamless access to OneLake-scale analytics.

sessions.title: Use graph reasoning to power your AI agents
sessions.desc: Agents are only as good as the connected context they reason over. See how graph reasoning helps AI understand relationships, dependencies, paths, and business meaning across enterprise data. This session shows how graph patterns and analytics help your teams and agents find insights that are not available otherwise.

sessions.title: Azure HorizonDB: Deep dive into architecture and internals
sessions.desc: Modern AI apps and agents demand low latency, scale-out architecture, enterprise resiliency, and native AI capabilities. See how Azure HorizonDB supports mission-critical applications in the AI era, and how Azure Managed Redis cuts the cost and latency of repeated retrieval and model work through semantic caching and close-at-hand context and memory. Compare hits and misses across response time, database load, and token use. Leave with guidance on cache selection, thresholds, and invalidation.

sessions.title: Data foundations for modern apps, AI, and agents
sessions.desc: Every AI application and agent depends on a strong data foundation. Join Shireesh Thota, CVP of Engineering for Databases to explore how Microsoft databases help organizations modernize mission-critical applications while building a new generation of intelligent experiences. Through vision, product innovations, and live demos, discover how operational, analytical, relational, and NoSQL data platforms work together to power modern applications, AI agents, and business transformation.

sessions.title: Less hunting, more building: Database agents in a unified estate
sessions.desc: Growing data estates create fragmented tools, limited visibility, and operational complexity that slows innovation. See how database hub in Fabric and database agents work with the tools your teams already use—SSMS and the MSSQL extension for VS Code—to surface the issues that matter, explain the likely cause, recommend a fix, and act with your approval. Come away with practical ways to reduce risk, cut operational overhead, and boost productivity, no matter where your data lives.

sessions.title: Powering AI with Azure Databricks, Foundry, Fabric, and Copilot
sessions.desc: AI is only as powerful as the data behind it. Join this session to explore how Azure Databricks can power the next generation of AI experiences through deep integrations with OneLake, Fabric, Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power BI, Teams, and Microsoft 365. Learn how to build a governed, open data estate with Unity Catalog, activate trusted enterprise data for copilots and AI agents, and accelerate business outcomes with shared governance, interoperability, and enterprise-scale analytics.
speakers: Head of Product, Azure Data Lake Storage & Azure Databricks

sessions.title: Build self-optimizing AI agents with Azure Cosmos DB and Fabric
sessions.desc: Everyone's shipping AI agents - but are they fast, cheap, and actually working? We'll instrument a multi-agent app with Azure Cosmos DB and Fabric to analyze cost, latency, and outcomes and build feedback loops for optimization. sessions.title: Database SOS: Choosing the right engine for your job
sessions.desc: Apps and AI agents rely on databases to serve data that's fresh, fast, and scalable. Join experts as they explore different Azure Databases, and share insights on how to choose for your next project.

sessions.title: Designing the data layer for AI apps and agents with Azure Cosmos DB
sessions.desc: AI apps and multi-agent systems need operational data, memory, state, and retrieval to work together. Learn how to design these patterns with Azure Cosmos DB through real-world use cases and customer examples. See how full-text, vector, hybrid, semantic, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval can ground agents in current application data, while Azure Cosmos DB supports conversation history, memory, personalization, and global production scale.

sessions.title: Postgres in production on Azure: Lessons in fleet modernization
sessions.desc: Running PostgreSQL at scale requires performance, security, resilience, and cost efficiency.
