sessions.title: One database, many agents: Scaling AI apps with Azure SQL Hyperscale
sessions.desc: AI applications are evolving beyond chat and copilots into systems that reason, retrieve context, maintain memory, and take action. These workloads demand a database that can unify transactional, vector, analytical, and agentic workloads without sacrificing scale, performance, or governance. Learn how Azure SQL Hyperscale provides the foundation for building production-ready AI applications with the scale and resilience required for the agentic era.

sessions.title: Build integrated AI apps with Azure HorizonDB
sessions.desc: Build AI applications grounded in operational data without assembling a fragmented data stack. See how Azure HorizonDB brings PostgreSQL data together with AI functions, durable AI pipelines, vector and hybrid search, semantic ranking, and knowledge graphs. Through a fast-paced technical walkthrough and live demo, learn how to transform continuously changing operational data into powerful, connected, and context-aware AI experiences.

sessions.title: Why Azure is the best cloud for SQL
sessions.desc: Why is Azure the best home for SQL? Join us to explore how Azure delivers a consistent SQL experience across on-premises, cloud, and Fabric—simplifying data estates and maximizing existing investments. Discover how Azure SQL improves performance, strengthens security, and optimizes costs with flexible scaling. Learn how to modernize mission-critical workloads and build a foundation for AI-powered applications without compromising the reliability and governance your business depends on.

sessions.title: Where agents meet analytics: Build with SQL Database in Fabric
sessions.desc: Build AI agents on operational data and turn every interaction into insight with SQL database in Microsoft Fabric. See how native vectors, governed data access, MCP, and built-in mirroring to OneLake connect agentic applications with analytics on a shared data foundation.

sessions.title: Build AI-ready apps on Azure SQL with GitHub Copilot in VS Code
sessions.desc: Go from an idea to an AI-ready SQL app with the MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code and GitHub Copilot. sessions.title: Beyond the cache: Scaling Sitecore Content Hub with AKS and Redis
sessions.desc: Modern SaaS platforms must deliver fast, reliable experiences while serving customers at dramatically different scales. sessions.title: Migrate and modernize MongoDB applications with Azure DocumentDB
sessions.desc: Learn how to move existing MongoDB applications to Azure DocumentDB with less migration risk and disruption. See how the latest Azure DocumentDB capabilities help teams move beyond migration and modernize on Azure.

sessions.title: Headless CRM: Accelerate revenue and pipeline with agentic sales
sessions.desc: What happens when CRM stops tracking work and starts doing it? Welcome to agentic CRM. Discover how headless Dynamics 365 Sales, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and AI agents transform CRM from a system of record into a system of action. Learn how organizations reduce administrative burden, automate sales processes, and equip every seller with an AI-powered sales team. Explore Microsoft’s vision for Dynamics 365 Sales in the flow of work, where people and agents collaborate to drive revenue growth.

sessions.title: Resolve customer issues faster with agentic customer service
sessions.desc: Customer service is evolving beyond traditional CRM and agent desktops into autonomous operations where people and AI agents resolve issues faster and deliver better experiences. Discover how Dynamics 365 Customer Service brings together Copilot, AI agents, customer engagement, Teams, and contact center capabilities to turn systems of record into systems of action. sessions.title: Host apps from anywhere with the new Copilot Managed Runtime
sessions.desc: Build AI apps on the platform of your choice and bring them into Microsoft for enterprise management. Discover how to deliver AI innovation without sacrificing the controls and oversight your organization requires.

sessions.title: Build Customer-Facing Agents in Copilot Studio, Teams, and CCAI
sessions.desc: Your customers reach you on your website, in your apps, over messaging, and by phone. Copilot Studio is where you agentify every one of those conversations. Author once and publish across all of them, including Teams Phone, with the same knowledge and behavior consistent across every channel. When a conversation calls for a human agent, it hands off to Contact Center AI with full context and your integrations intact. See how the new Customer Conversation Harness makes it work.

sessions.title: Agentify your customer interactions with Dynamics 365 Contact Center
sessions.desc: Modernizing a contact center takes more than adding AI. Learn how organizations are improving self-service, increasing productivity, and delivering better customer experiences with less complexity.

sessions.title: Modernize your contact center without rip and replace
sessions.desc: Customers expect every interaction to be fast, personalized, and resolved on the first contact, yet many organizations are constrained by long technology refresh cycles. Learn how to accelerate time to value, improve containment rates, and deliver more efficient, high-quality customer experiences.

sessions.title: Deploy and manage Power Platform at enterprise scale
sessions.desc: Building a solution is only the beginning. Learn how to deploy, govern, and operate Power Platform solutions at enterprise scale. sessions.title: What’s new in Dynamics 365 Business Central​

sessions.desc: As Copilot, Cowork, and agents take on more work across finance and operations, organizations face new decisions about ERP strategy and architecture. sessions.title: What’s new in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service​

​

sessions.title: Frontier Telecoms: Intelligence, Trust and the partners who build them

sessions.title: Building agentic financial services solutions with Microsoft​

Discover how to move from information access to faster decisions while maintaining the governance, security, and control required by financial institutions.​

sessions.title: In Their Words: Building Government AI With Partners​

sessions.title: Why human skills matter for your AI outcome

Learn from real-world experiences in accelerating AI adoption, empowering employees, and building the workforce capabilities needed to drive change at scale.​

sessions.title: Redesign the work, not just the task​
sessions.desc: Many of the biggest AI opportunities come from more than automating a single task. Learn how leaders can identify workflows ready for reinvention and redesign work around the combined strengths of people and AI.​

sessions.title: More Valuable, Not Less: Designing Work Around Human Judgment
sessions.desc: As AI capabilities expand, human judgment, creativity, domain expertise, and leadership become more valuable, not less. sessions.title: Name the constraint: Five drivers of Frontier Transformation

sessions.title: From pilot to payoff: Driving AI outcomes for every business
sessions.desc: AI has moved from experimentation to execution. sessions.title: Your Most Valuable AI Asset Isn't a Model

sessions.title: Delegate the Work, Keep the Accountability: A Governance Model for AI

sessions.title: Lost in San Francisco: Build AI agents that find their way

sessions.title: Ready for AI: A Zero Trust Workshop
sessions.desc: Work the Zero Trust for AI Workshop hands-on. Baseline your environment, apply the new DevSecOps and AI memory guidance, and leave with a prioritized 12-24 month roadmap across identity, devices, data, network, AI and SecOps.

sessions.title: Deploy Copilot with confidence: Find & protect exposed sensitive data
sessions.desc: Prepare your organization for secure AI adoption. In this hands-on lab, assess oversharing risks, identify exposed sensitive data, apply labels and policy controls, and validate that Microsoft Copilot can scale without exposing critical information.

sessions.title: Ship AI apps fast with Rayfin, a managed backend as a service
sessions.desc: Build a field technician productivity app with Rayfin using coding agents. Generate a full-stack app on Microsoft Fabric without manually configuring backend services, then connect to Foundry and Fabric data agents to surface service insights in the experience. Leave with a working app and a repeatable pattern to ship data-driven, production-ready apps faster, without backend complexity.

sessions.title: Build an AI-ready data foundation with Microsoft OneLake
sessions.desc: Learn how to unify and govern your data estate with Microsoft OneLake. In this hands-on lab, you'll connect data from multiple sources, explore zero-copy data access patterns, discover and share data across teams, and apply governance controls to create trusted, reusable data assets. Leave with practical skills for preparing data for analytics, AI, and intelligent applications.

sessions.title: Build a grounded AI agent with Azure HorizonDB for PostgreSQL
sessions.desc: Your agent is only as good as the data behind it. Join us to build a working agent that retrieves trusted context from operational PostgreSQL data in Azure HorizonDB. Create an AI pipeline, generate embeddings, combine vector and keyword retrieval, apply filters, and connect results to an agent workflow. Leave with a reusable architecture and working implementation.

sessions.title: Building reliable AI apps and agents with Azure SQL Database
sessions.desc: Learn how to build production-ready AI applications and agents powered by Azure SQL. In this hands-on lab, you'll prepare Azure SQL Database as a resilient RAG data source, implement hybrid search that combines vector and keyword retrieval, and integrate your retrieval layer with applications and AI agents. Leave with practical patterns you can apply immediately to build reliable, scalable AI solutions.

sessions.title: Accelerate Salesforce Migration with Dynamics 365 Activate
sessions.desc: Get hands-on with Dynamics 365 Activate and experience an end-to-end Salesforce-to-Dynamics 365 migration. Connect Activate to a provided Salesforce test environment, run discovery, explore schema and migration scope, configure Dataverse mappings, and execute a trial migration. See how Activate unifies discovery, mapping, and migration in a guided workflow. By the end, you'll know how to assess, prepare, and validate a Salesforce migration to Dynamics 365.

sessions.title: Provisioning and Configuring Windows 365 for Agentic Workloads
sessions.desc: In this hands-on lab, participants will deploy and manage Windows 365 for Agents, Microsoft’s secure Cloud PC platform for AI agents. Guided exercises cover provisioning agent workloads, creating policies, configuring security and compliance controls, integrating with Microsoft Intune and Entra ID, and managing the agent lifecycle. Attendees will learn how to operationalize and scale agentic workloads while maintaining enterprise governance, security, and compliance.

sessions.title: Build an AI-Ready Secure Foundation with Zero Trust
sessions.desc: Discover the enhanced Microsoft Zero Trust Workshop — now covering all six technical pillars. Explore how Intune and Entra secure identities and devices, with new implementation indicators and cross-pillar guidance. Build a tailored roadmap, track progress, and leverage the latest integrations to accelerate adoption and boost your security posture.

sessions.title: Manage Endpoint Protection with Microsoft Intune and Defender
sessions.desc: Using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, you'll configure endpoint security policies, validate device posture, investigate endpoint issues, and remediate devices through Intune. Learn how security and IT teams use shared device context to identify protection gaps, verify actions, and build a trusted endpoint foundation for secure AI adoption.

sessions.title: Hands-on: Modernize apps and databases and automate operations
sessions.desc: Get hands-on using AI to modernize applications, databases, and operations. Use GitHub Copilot to assess and upgrade a Java or .NET app, remediate dependencies, containerize workloads, and modernize the database. Then use Azure SRE Agent to investigate incidents, identify root causes, and automate remediation. Leave with practical experience applying AI agents across the modernization and operations lifecycle.

sessions.title: Hands-on with the resiliency in Azure: Assess, recommend, recover
sessions.desc: In this hands-on lab, experience Azure resiliency across availability, disaster recovery, data resiliency, and cyber recovery. Define resiliency goals for a sample workload, assess readiness against zonal and regional failures, identify gaps against RTO/RPO targets, and apply guided recommendations to improve resiliency. Perform clean-room recovery to restore trusted data after an attack and leave with a practical, repeatable approach using Azure resiliency capabilities and AI-assisted guidance.

sessions.title: Operate secure, multi-tenant agentic apps on Azure Container Apps
sessions.desc: Build the skills to run multi-tenant isolated AI workloads in production. You will place a workload in the right isolation boundary for user separation, contain untrusted code, scale from zero, right size CPU and memory for per second billing, and snapshot and resume sessions so stateful work can continue. Everything runs on Azure Container Apps with microVM-backed compute. Leave with a decision tree and patterns you can apply to your own workloads.

sessions.title: Build, observe, and scale AI-ready apps and workloads with AKS
sessions.desc: Deploy and operate AI inference on AKS without building a cluster from scratch. Deploy a prepared AI application to AKS Automatic, request GPU resources, and watch Automatic provision the required compute. You then run inference, inspect application and GPU metrics, generate load, and observe scaling. A final Ray exercise demonstrates distributed AI on the same AKS foundation. The lab follows an AI workload from container image to a secure, observable, scalable deployment.

sessions.title: Govern your estate with Azure Arc and Azure Resource Manager MCP
sessions.desc: Roll up your sleeves for a 75-minute interactive lab. Use your own AI agents and Azure Resource Manager MCP Server to explore real-time inventory, policy compliance, cost insights, and user-controlled deployments. Onboard, monitor, govern, and secure Azure VMs and on-premises servers through Azure Arc. You’ll also enable Extended Security Updates for Windows Server 2016 while building a practical modernization plan for your hybrid estate.

sessions.title: Hands-on: Network monitoring and troubleshooting
sessions.desc: Join to gain practical experience with Azure network monitoring, troubleshooting, traffic analytics, and security insights. Through real-world scenarios such as ExpressRoute monitoring and Private Link traffic visibility, you'll learn which tools to use, when to use them, and how to interpret data effectively. By the end, you'll be equipped to improve network resilience, strengthen security, accelerate issue resolution, reduce operational overhead, and enhance application performance.

sessions.title: Build healthcare agents with foundation and reasoning models
sessions.desc: Learn how to combine healthcare foundation models in Microsoft Foundry with Microsoft AI reasoning models to build intelligent healthcare agents that can analyze, orchestrate, and act on multimodal healthcare data. Explore how they can synthesize information across systems, coordinate workflows, and support clinical, operational, and research scenarios. Discover how agents can deliver context-aware insights that can help healthcare professionals make more informed decisions.
speakers: Senior Director, Product Management, Microsoft AI Health

sessions.title: CXO Workshop: Build executive focus with a Chief of Staff agent
sessions.desc: You're buried in email, chats, and meetings while priorities keep shifting. In this workshop, you'll build a Chief of Staff agent that transforms your Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts into a consistent leadership persona, helping you streamline meeting prep, accelerate drafting, and make better day-to-day decisions.

sessions.title: From AI anxiety to organizational advantage
sessions.desc: Employees, customers, and boards are asking what AI means for the future of work. This interactive workshop explores how executives can turn uncertainty into opportunity through leadership, workforce readiness, and responsible AI adoption.

sessions.title: Live from Microsoft Ignite
sessions.desc: Join us for Live at Microsoft Ignite, a dynamic broadcast that explores the future of AI through discussions with industry experts, in-depth demos, and more. Join us in person at The Hub or watch online and check out the latest innovations shaping the ways we live and work.

sessions.title: Web search controls for Microsoft Copilot
sessions.desc: Organizations often face a tradeoff between AI innovation and compliance requirements. Discover how web search controls in Microsoft Copilot help you safely access and ground responses in web content while supporting security, privacy, compliance, and sovereignty needs.

sessions.title: Show, Don't Tell: Helping Teams Discover the Value of Copilot
sessions.desc: The fastest path to Copilot adoption is helping employees see how it improves the work they do every day. In this session, we'll share practical activities that make AI tangible for teams. You'll leave with actions you can take to spark engagement and build momentum.

sessions.title: The Copilot Adoption Playbook: Practical Steps to Get Started
sessions.desc: What should organizations do first when rolling out Copilot? In this lightning session, we'll break down the important first steps for AI leaders, IT administrators and AI Champions , helping you create a foundation for sustainable usage and business impact.

sessions.title: Copilot Champions in Action
sessions.desc:
In this lightning talk, we'll showcase real customer stories and practical adoption tactics from Champions who successfully introduced, launched, and scaled Copilot within their organizations.
From training activities and activation campaigns to community building and ongoing engagement, you'll discover the strategies Champions use to create momentum and sustain adoption.

sessions.title: Preparing for usage-based billing
sessions.desc: Learn practical approaches to visibility, governance, forecasting, optimization, and flexible purchasing that help organizations accelerate AI adoption while keeping investments aligned to business outcomes.

sessions.title: Your Work, Anywhere: The New OneDrive Experience Across Web and Mobile
sessions.desc: Work happens everywhere, and OneDrive is evolving to help you stay productive wherever you are. Explore the latest OneDrive experiences across web and mobile, designed to help you quickly find, organize, and act on content from any device. See new innovations, real-world productivity scenarios, and how OneDrive helps you stay connected, streamline tasks, and work smarter across Microsoft 365.

sessions.title: Deploy OneDrive Sync with Confidence: The Desktop Playbook
sessions.desc: Learn how to successfully deploy and manage OneDrive Sync across your organization. Explore deployment best practices, configuration tips, user adoption strategies, and troubleshooting guidance to deliver a reliable and scalable file sync experience for your users.

sessions.title: The foundation of Trusted AI: SharePoint security and resiliency
sessions.desc: Trusted AI starts with trusted content. As agents and Copilot experiences become integral to business workflows in Microsoft 365, SharePoint security and resiliency are more critical than ever. Join us to see how the #1 citation source of Copilot - SharePoint protects organizational knowledge, ensures resilience against threats and disruptions, and provides the trusted foundation for AI at enterprise scale.

sessions.title: Customer Zero: How Microsoft Uses Agents to Scale Knowledge Work
sessions.desc: How can organizations move beyond AI assistants to transform how work gets done? As Customer Zero, Microsoft is exploring how agents can scale expertise, reduce repetitive work, and accelerate decisions. Learn how teams combine human judgment with agentic workflows to keep knowledge current and create tailored outputs on demand. Hear lessons on human-agent collaboration, governance, trust, and adoption—and get guidance for moving from isolated AI experiments to scalable business processes.

sessions.title: AI That Pays Off: New Ways to Measure Value and Optimize Spend
sessions.desc: AI investment is growing fast. Are you getting the return to match? Discover new in-product ROI reporting capabilities that connect AI usage, spend, and business impact. Understand the science behind the metrics and identify what’s driving value, where to optimize costs, and which initiatives to scale next.

sessions.title: Getting Started with Agent 365: Setting Up Your Agent Control Plane
sessions.desc: You've purchased Agent 365. Now what? This Lightning Talk covers what IT and Security teams can do to get started with Agent 365: discover the agents already running in your environment, bring agent sprawl under control, get ahead of data leaks or vulnerabilities, and more. Leave with pragmatic next steps to deploy Agent 365 as your organization's agent control plane.

sessions.title: How Microsoft is Scaling Thousands of AI Agents with Agent 365
sessions.desc: What does it take to manage thousands of AI agents across a global enterprise? Join Microsoft for an inside look at how we're using Agent 365 to observe, govern, and secure agents at scale. Learn how we gain visibility across our agent ecosystem, implement controls that enable confident deployment, and move from isolated experimentation to enterprise-wide adoption. Leave with practical lessons and best practices for managing agents across your organization.

sessions.title: Why every community needs an agent
sessions.desc: Communities succeed because people help people. Learn how agents built on communities, conversations, and organizational knowledge can answer questions, surface expertise, connect people to content, identify trends, and turn conversations into reusable knowledge, while keeping humans at the center. See how these signals power AI experiences like Cowork, Autopilot, Work IQ, and the workplace of the future.

sessions.title: The power of listening
sessions.desc: When women seek care, being heard can make all the difference, but time pressures and administrative demands often get in the way. Learn how Dragon Copilot helps clinicians build a more complete picture of each patient, with safeguards and human oversight built in. By creating more space to listen and focus on human connection, providers can make more informed care decisions and improve the patient experience.

sessions.title: Scale Enterprise AI Transformation with Frontier Accelerate
sessions.desc: Scaling AI across the enterprise requires more than technology. Learn how Frontier Accelerate helps leaders align priorities, modernize processes, build workforce readiness, and create a secure foundation for adoption. Through examples across productivity, business processes, secure AI, and intelligent apps, see how expertise, investments, and skilling resources help organizations accelerate transformation.

sessions.title: AI-Powered Workplace: AI removes the taxes on teamwork
sessions.desc: Work charges a tax: hunting space, guessing the right day, joining from the edge. AI removes it. The workplace knows why you came in and who's there. It reads the space and everyone in it, and adapts to how people actually work. Reach scales without losing the audience. Copilot and agents thread it all together. The result is a workplace that anticipates instead of asks, where collaboration feels seamless and natural, and being in the office is the best seat, not the only one.

sessions.title: Run your week: Five ways to use Copilot and Planner to manage work
sessions.desc: Managing work means keeping track of tasks, follow-ups, meeting preparation, and shifting priorities. Join this fast-paced session to explore at least five practical ways to use Copilot and Planner to keep work moving across Microsoft 365.

sessions.title: The End of Starting Over: AI That Understands Your Work
sessions.desc: Memory is the connective tissue across M365 Copilot, carrying what you're working on and how you work from one session to the next. Discover how memory within Copilot is transforming it from an AI that responds in the moment into one that builds understanding over time. Learn how Copilot retains what matters, adapts as you and your work evolve, and uses that context to deliver more relevant, personalized experiences. See how memory is foundational to AI that truly understands you and your work.

sessions.title: Skills for agents: reusable expertise that scales
sessions.desc: What separates a good agent from a great one? Skills. Learn how reusable, task-specific expertise helps agents deliver more consistent, useful, and scalable results. Through practical examples, you'll discover when to use skills, how to design them effectively, and where they can have the biggest impact.

sessions.title: Interactive post-Training: Own the loop, not the GPUs
sessions.desc: Build supervised or reinforcement fine-tuning workflows with Microsoft Foundry's serverless Interactive Post-Training API. Control sampling, training steps, and checkpointing with your own loss functions, rewards, rollout logic, data, and hyperparameters. Foundry manages the GPUs while you control how models learn. Go from Python code to a customized model artifact with self-service, pay-as-you-go post-training, without securing GPU quota or managing a fleet.

sessions.title: Foundry Labs: Research models you can try before you leave Ignite
sessions.desc: A fast tour of what's live in Microsoft Foundry Labs right now across biomedical, geospatial, robotics, and agentic domains. See what each experimental model does, what it's not ready for, and how to fork one into your own Foundry project today. Fifteen minutes in, you'll have a shortlist and a link.

sessions.title: Build an AI incident commander with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
sessions.desc: Major incidents demand rapid coordination across people, systems, and data, yet much of the response process remains manual. In this hands-on session, you'll build an AI Incident Commander using Foundry Agent Service that can orchestrate investigations, coordinate specialized agents, analyze telemetry, generate stakeholder updates, and drive incidents from detection to resolution. You'll learn how to leverage hosted agents, routines, and tools to create long-running operational workflows.

sessions.title: Beyond the tools: Preparing your employees to thrive with AI
sessions.desc: As AI becomes more capable, how do you help your employees make the most of it? Explore how employees’ roles evolve as they work alongside AI and agents, from creating work to directing it, and why human skills become even more valuable. Leave with practical ideas for developing your teams’ skills and confidence, beyond teaching them how to use the tools.

sessions.title: Let GitHub Copilot find and fix a browser bug
sessions.desc: Watch GitHub Copilot open an app reproduce a bug collect evidence update the code and confirm the fix in a browser. See how sandboxes permissions tests and human review keep the agent focused and make the result easy to trust.

sessions.title: When AI agents can use a computer
sessions.desc: AI agents are moving beyond chat and code. They can now navigate websites use business tools collect information and complete work across applications. See practical examples and learn how to decide what agents can access where they should stop and when a person must approve the next step. Built for IT admins security teams and technology leaders.

sessions.title: Find and fix AI vulnerabilities before you ship agents
sessions.desc: Building AI applications requires defending against a new class of security vulnerabilities. Join this demo-led session to see how GitHub Advanced Security helps identify AI-specific weaknesses directly in code, including risks associated with prompt injection and untrusted data sources. Watch real examples, learn remediation techniques, and discover how to ship AI agents and applications with greater confidence and fewer security surprises.

sessions.title: The browser for every agent: Remote MCP Playwright Cloud Browser
sessions.desc: Browser automation is becoming a core capability for agentic applications. This session explores how Remote MCP exposes Playwright Cloud Browser as a shared browser service across Copilot, Foundry, GitHub Copilot, and custom agents. Learn how it enables reliable web navigation, data extraction, and task execution, with built-in observability to simplify debugging. We’ll also demonstrate secure access to public websites and private VNet applications for enterprise-ready browser automation.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot can approve PRs. What does AI approval actually mean?
sessions.desc: GitHub Copilot can now approve a pull request, but an AI assessment and an approval that satisfies a merge rule are not the same thing. We’ll walk through an example pull request to learn what Copilot considers before approving, and how teams can use that signal in their review workflows. See how admins control Copilot approval at the enterprise, organization, and repository levels. You’ll have the context to decide where an AI approval belongs in your review policy.

sessions.title: Build a plugin once and use it everywhere with GitHub Copilot!
sessions.desc: In this lightning session, learn how to build one agent plugin and use it across VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and GitHub Copilot App. See how portable plugins bring reusable skills and MCP integrations to each environment while still feeling native. Leave with a practical blueprint for shipping cross-surface agent experiences.

sessions.title: Control how AI agents operate across GitHub
sessions.desc: AI agents can transform how software gets built, but enterprises need confidence that they operate within organizational policies. During this 15 minute demo, see how a GitHub administrator can define enterprise guardrails for agents running on the GitHub platform, giving teams room to move quickly while maintaining security, compliance, and control.

sessions.title: Inside the new GitHub Copilot agent harness in Visual Studio
sessions.desc: Agent Mode in Visual Studio has been rebuilt on the GitHub Copilot SDK. Watch agents break down complex tasks, invoke tools, edit code, and carry work through a real-world development scenario. See how GitHub Copilot’s production-proven runtime powers agentic workflows in Visual Studio with support for both Copilot and BYOK models. Walk away with a deeper understanding of the architecture and practical guidance for adopting agentic workflows in your development process.

sessions.title: From feedback to fixes: Event-driven coding agents
sessions.desc: A new pull request review shouldn't leave a coding agent waiting for its next API poll. GitHub's Events Streams API lets agents subscribe to changes and react when feedback arrives. Watch an agent address a review and prepare code updates for human approval. You'll learn how to connect GitHub events to coding agents, build reactive agentic workflows, and shorten the feedback-to-fix cycle without polling loops or public webhook infrastructure.

sessions.title: Keep GitHub Copilot agent sessions moving wherever you work
sessions.desc: Agent work should not stop because you closed a folder or changed where you are working. Start a GitHub Copilot session in VS Code, keep it running in the Agent Host, then reconnect through the Agents window and a browser to monitor progress, guide the agent, approve actions, and review changes. See how the open Agent Host Protocol keeps one long-running session synchronized across clients, so you can choose the right surface for each moment without losing context or starting over.

sessions.title: From prompt to hosted: The next generation of agents
sessions.desc: Prompt-based agents helped developers get started, but production workloads demand more. This session explores the evolution from prompt agents to hosted agents, covering identity, sessions, tool integration, resiliency, deployment pipelines and enterprise governance. Learn how teams are moving from prototypes to scalable AI systems while preserving developer productivity and choice.

sessions.title: Optimizing AI decisions with the model router in Foundry Models
sessions.desc: Model router in Foundry Models continues to evolve with new capabilities that give developers greater control over how requests are routed across models. In this session, we'll highlight the latest innovations in model router and show how teams can optimize quality, latency, and cost for AI applications and agents. You'll see how model router helps simplify model selection, adapt to changing workloads, and improve application performance at scale.

sessions.title: From idea to agent in minutes with Foundry Canvas
sessions.desc: What if building an AI agent felt as natural as sketching an idea? This session showcases Foundry Canvas and its vision for simplifying agent creation through visual design, model selection, toolbox integration and deployment workflows. Learn how developers can move from concept to running agent faster, reduce setup complexity, and focus on delivering business value instead of wiring infrastructure together.

sessions.title: Microsoft Foundry Toolkit: The developer shortcut to production
sessions.desc: Modern AI development requires more than models. Foundry Toolkit brings together development, testing, deployment and management experiences in one workflow. Discover how developers can accelerate agent engineering, connect tools and services, iterate faster, and reduce friction between local experimentation and enterprise deployment. Ideal for teams building production-ready AI applications at scale.

sessions.title: Agent optimization with Microsoft Foundry Toolkit
sessions.desc: Tracing shows what happened. Evaluation shows whether it was successful. Optimization helps agents improve. Learn how observability, evaluations, agent insights and optimization loops combine to create continuously improving AI systems. This session focuses on practical engineering patterns for measuring quality, reducing cost and increasing business value from agent deployments.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot Harness meets enterprise agent hosting
sessions.desc: Developers want the flexibility of code-first frameworks with enterprise-grade operations. This session explores how GitHub Copilot Harness, managed agents and hosted runtimes work together to streamline development, deployment and management. Learn how existing agent code can evolve into secure, governed and scalable production applications.

sessions.title: Agent FinOps: Designing agents that scale responsibly
sessions.desc: As agents become long-running and autonomous, cost management becomes a core engineering concern. Discover practical approaches to measuring ROI, controlling resource consumption and balancing performance with efficiency. Learn how optimization, monitoring and operational governance help teams move from experimental agents to sustainable production systems.

sessions.title: Governance of tools and skills with Foundry Toolboxes
sessions.desc: The future is not a single agent but ecosystems of agents, tools and skills. Learn how reusable toolboxes, skills platforms, MCP integrations and agent orchestration can accelerate development while improving maintainability. Explore emerging patterns for composing capabilities once and enabling their reuse across teams, projects and business processes.

sessions.title: Publishing agents where work actually happens
sessions.desc: Building an agent is only half the challenge. Delivering it to users is where value is created. Learn about emerging patterns for publishing agents into Teams, Microsoft 365 and existing business workflows. We explore governance, discoverability, distribution and the lessons learned from connecting developer experiences to the applications people use every day.

sessions.title: From single call to agent: Build with Claude tool capabilities
sessions.desc: Teams building with Claude often recreate the same agent infrastructure: structured outputs, web search and fetch, MCP connectivity, and tool routing. These capabilities are now GA for Claude on Azure in Microsoft Foundry. See how to use them with working code, enterprise patterns, and production guidance on token economics, domain allowlists, prompt-injection risk, and governance for tool access.

sessions.title: Package custom models for adoption in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.desc: Publishing weights makes a model available, not adoptable. In 15 minutes, see how Microsoft Foundry turns a custom model into a complete product with task-specific evaluators, reference prompts, a working harness, integration guidance, and evidence on quality, performance, and cost. Learn which assets accelerate time to value, create differentiation beyond the weights, and help customers evaluate, customize, and deploy with confidence.

sessions.title: Beyond search: Enabling agents to operate business critical systems
sessions.desc: Most enterprise agents can search. The real opportunity is agents that act. See how Work IQ, MCP servers, and enterprise connectors extend agents into ERP, CRM, ITSM, and other business systems where work actually happens. Learn how to create reusable business skills that connect systems, automate actions, and can be shared across copilots and agents throughout your organization.

sessions.title: Fabric IQ + Foundry IQ: From business data to agent knowledge
sessions.desc: See how Fabric IQ and Foundry IQ work together: Fabric IQ brings OneLake data, business semantics, and metrics; Foundry IQ turns that context into agent-ready knowledge through retrieval. Learn where each fits in the Microsoft IQ stack.

sessions.title: Observability for AI with Fabric Data Agent, Foundry, and Agent 365
sessions.desc: As organizations move AI into production, they need visibility into how AI apps perform and how agents operate. See how Microsoft Foundry and Fabric Data Agent help teams monitor AI operations, investigate issues, and uncover insights. The new integration with Microsoft Agent 365 gives admins visibility into Fabric Data Agent usage and activity org-wide. Together, they offer a connected approach to troubleshooting and managing AI, from applications to the enterprise agent estate.

sessions.title: Enterprise-ready agents require an enterprise-ready data platform
sessions.desc: Every agent is only as effective as the data it can understand and act on. Learn how Dataverse provides the trusted foundation that enables agents to participate in real business processes while maintaining governance, security, and accountability. Discover how leading organizations are preparing their data for an agent-driven future and leave with practical guidance for making your business data agent-ready.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot meets Microsoft IQ: Bringing enterprise context to devs
sessions.desc: Join a conversation on how Microsoft IQ can bring enterprise context into the developer workflow through GitHub Copilot. Explore how business data, workplace knowledge, and retrieval-powered context can help developers reason across code, docs, workflows, and organizational knowledge.

sessions.title: How Foundry IQ delivers context to your AI apps and agents
sessions.desc: Learn how Foundry IQ goes beyond vector search to model knowledge as a connected context graph for AI apps and agents. See how graph-based relationships, structured knowledge, and retrieval work together to help agents reason across entities, dependencies, and business context.

sessions.title: Identity-aware knowledge retrieval with Foundry IQ
sessions.desc: AI agents rely on retrieved knowledge to answer questions, but not every user should have access to every document. This session shows how Foundry IQ enables identity-aware knowledge retrieval using document-level access controls, Microsoft Entra ID user and group filtering, and permission-aware retrieval. Learn how permissions from SharePoint, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and other enterprise content sources are enforced so agents retrieve only authorized content.

sessions.title: Knowledge retrieval for AI agents with Foundry IQ
sessions.desc: Discover how Foundry IQ connects knowledge across diverse data sources while preserving access controls and maximizing retrieval quality. Explore AI-optimized ingestion pipelines and knowledge architectures that unify indexed and remote sources.

sessions.title: WIQD in 15 minutes: Work IQ developer tools
sessions.desc: Meet WIQD, the new Work IQ developer tools for bringing workplace intelligence into the developer lifecycle. See how developers can connect Microsoft 365 context to agents and apps and accelerate enterprise-ready AI development.

sessions.title: Work IQ and Agent 365: Build and govern workplace agents
sessions.desc: Learn how Work IQ and Agent 365 work together to build useful workplace agents and govern them at scale. Ground agents in Microsoft 365 context, then see how Agent 365 supports visibility, lifecycle management, policy, security, and operational control.

sessions.title: Project Perception Live: From Exposure to Protection
sessions.desc: Watch a live demo of Project Perception as Red, Blue, and Green Team agents help identify risk, investigate threats, and accelerate protection.

sessions.title: From Prompt to Patch: AI-Powered Endpoint Vulnerability Management
sessions.desc: See how IT can use AI to explore endpoint risk in natural language, uncover and prioritize critical vulnerabilities, and move seamlessly from insight to governed remediation—then verify deployment and measurable risk reduction.

sessions.title: Why Every SOC Needs attack disruption
sessions.desc: Modern attacks move faster than human response. Join Microsoft security experts to learn how attack disruption helps stop attacks in progress, automatically containing threats and limiting attacker movement before damage occurs. Discover why autonomous defense is quickly becoming a core requirement for modern security operations.

sessions.title: Find and fix vulnerabilities faster with MDASH
sessions.desc: Learn from experts on how codename MDASH orchestrates specialized AI agents and security-focused AI models to identify, validate, and prioritize vulnerabilities, helping teams understand risk and focus on the issues that matter most.

sessions.title: Threat Intelligence reimagined: Expert Q&A and Deep Dive
sessions.desc: Have questions about Microsoft Threat Intelligence? Join an interactive discussion with product experts. Dive deeper into architecture, capabilities, and use cases. Bring your toughest questions and we'll answer them live with demos and real examples.

sessions.title: Fuel the agentic SOC with comprehensive security data
sessions.desc: AI is only as effective as the security data it can access. Learn from experts on how Microsoft Sentinel can help you expand visibility across your Microsoft and third-party environments with a broad connector ecosystem. We'll explore how richer security data improves detection, investigation, automation, and AI-powered workflows, enabling analysts and agents to work from a shared foundation of signals and context.

sessions.title: Threat-aware exposure management for the agentic age
sessions.desc: See a demo of how Microsoft Security Exposure Management prioritize exposure through threat intelligence, leverages Green Agents to shield, patach and remediate and helps you manage your security posture in the era of AI.

sessions.title: Apply Zero Trust for AI: the practitioner's shortlist
sessions.desc: Fifteen minutes, five controls. See the Zero Trust for AI guidance practitioners apply first across identity, data, endpoints and SecOps, how to baseline where you stand, and what to fix before your agents go live.

sessions.title: Defend your business-critical container apps from code to runtime
sessions.desc: Modern applications rely on containers. Microsoft Defender for Cloud helps security teams detect runtime threats, understand container activity, and investigate attacks using container and cloud context to respond faster and reduce incident impact.

sessions.title: Beyond Data Classification: Understanding Human and Data Interactions
sessions.desc: Data security isn't just knowing what's sensitive. It's understanding who can access data, how it's used, and whether that access fits the business need. Learn why user-data interactions are critical to reducing risk and securing AI.

sessions.title: Your External Users Expect a Frictionless Login. Attackers Do Too.​
sessions.desc: External users expect every interaction with your application to be fast, seamless, and secure. Attackers are looking for the gaps in that experience. See what’s new in Microsoft Entra External ID, with innovations that help you deliver low-friction customer experiences while strengthening protection for customer identities.

sessions.title: Oops! Someone Deleted a Critical Identity. Can You Get It Back?
sessions.desc: A deleted identity can quickly become a major business disruption, especially when it has dependencies across applications, groups, policies, and access. See how Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery helps protect critical identity data and recover from accidental or malicious changes. Learn how to build resilience into your identity environment before deletion becomes downtime.​

sessions.title: Govern and protect local agents for safe access enterprise resources
