See a classic service principal evolve into a governed Agent ID with accountability, auditing, and lifecycle controlsùand leave with a practical framework for production-ready agents.

sessions.title: AI Powered Development for Power Platform Professionals
sessions.desc: Build apps, sites, automations, AI experiences, and complete business solutions in minutesùnot days. Explore how Agentic AI, Power Platform, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, MCP servers, and AI Skills are transforming software development. Through practical demos, discover how AI can accelerate solution design, generate data models and workflows, orchestrate business logic, and deliver enterprise-grade solutions while maintaining governance, security, and scalability.

sessions.title: MCP Runs Both Ways: Governing Power Automate in the Agent Era
sessions.desc:
Two very different capabilities are both being called "Power Automate MCP," and the difference decides your governance model.
You'll leave with a publish-gate checklist, an environment pattern for agent-facing flows, and a clear answer to "which of our flows are exposed as tools, and running as whom?"

sessions.title: Skill Up for Success: Build Your Dynamics 365 Contact Center Practice
sessions.desc: Dynamics 365 Contact Center represents one of the fastest-growing opportunities in the Microsoft ecosystem, but where do partners start? This session provides a practical roadmap for building a successful practice, covering skills development, certifications, solution positioning, sales motions, AI capabilities, and implementation readiness. Learn how to identify opportunities, create customer value, and build a scalable business around Microsoft's AI-powered customer engagement platform.
speakers: Business Development Director - EMEA & APAC - MVP

sessions.title: Voice Agents That Ship: Real-Time AI in Dynamics 365 Contact Center
sessions.desc: Real-time voice agents are generally available in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. The demo always works. Production is harder. I build one live: barge-in, DTMF fallback, mid-call language switching, and deterministic handling for identity checks. Then I break it and show the escalation that carries full context to a human rep. You leave with a latency budget, the guardrails that matter, and the three failures that hit every deployment.

sessions.title: Azure Virtual Network Manager: Herding Networks the Easy Way
sessions.desc:
Ready to take control of Azure networking at scale? 

Join this fast-paced, demo-heavy session and see Azure Virtual Network Manager in action. 

Discover how centralized governance, consistent Virtual Network configuration, and built-in IP Address Management can cut complexity, boost confidence, and accelerate delivery. YouÆll walk away with practical design tips, real-world scenarios, important limits to know, and reusable demo code for your own Azure environment.

sessions.title: Generate Secure Azure Infrastructure with GitHub Copilot and Bicep
sessions.desc: See what GitHub Copilot can do when given real Azure architecture and security requirements. This code-led session builds a Bicep solution for a secure workload, then examines the generated modules, parameters, identities, networking, and deployment configuration. Learn how to detect omissions, correct unsafe assumptions, and validate AI-generated infrastructure before deployment.

sessions.title: IoT Edge or IoT Operations? Lessons from the Field
sessions.desc: IoT Edge or Azure IoT Operations? The answer isnÆt simply old versus new, or hardware to host! Drawing on lessons from real-world IoT projects in the last 12 years, this session explores why some solutions still start with IoT Edge while others require IoT Operations. Let's examine scale, Kubernetes, infrastructure, connectivity, operations, edge AI, team readiness, and lifecycle management. The key point here is to share field lessons learned that help architects choose the right approach.

sessions.title: Landing Zone Governance: From Audit to Deny Before It Drifts
sessions.desc:
Most Azure Landing Zone guardrail policies ship as Audit, not Deny | that's safe for rollout because nothing blocks deployment. Over time, that default causes environments to drift: Audit reports violations but doesn't stop them, and once go-live pressure fades, few teams tighten it.

This session explains how to decide which controls need Deny from day one versus which stay Audit, using real governance patterns: a framework for deciding before go-live, not after a finding.

sessions.title: The Enterprise AI Landing Zone: One Foundation for Many Teams
sessions.desc: Enterprise AI rarely scales when every team builds its own environment. This session designs an Azure AI landing zone for Microsoft Foundry, covering subscription and management group placement, private connectivity, Microsoft Entra ID, and Azure Policy. WeÆll live onboard a second team against an existing estate, showing what breaks under inherited policies and why. Leave with a reference architecture and practical onboarding checklist for your distributed enterprise AI teams.

sessions.title: Adopting AI at a Non-Profit: 5 things that work
sessions.desc: Learn five keys to successfully adopting AI at work, in a financially responsible way, pulled from my experience deploying Copilot Basic, Copilot Premium, and Copilot Cowork at a non-profit, non-partisan research institute.

sessions.title: Beyond the Prompt: Driving Real Value with Microsoft 365 Copilot
sessions.desc: Deploying Microsoft 365 Copilot is only the first step. How do you know users are getting real value? In this session, learn practical strategies to drive adoption, measure impact, and help employees move from occasional use to daily productivity gains. We'll explore proven approaches for identifying high-value scenarios, building effective habits, and demonstrating ROI. You'll also see how capabilities like SharePoint agents and Agent Builder can further enhance the Copilot experience.

sessions.title: Copilot Cowork: Daily Use Cases to Get Real Work Delegated
sessions.desc: Copilot Chat answers questions. Cowork does work. But most users treat Cowork like a bigger chat window and miss the point. I'll demo the daily use cases where delegating beats prompting: multi-step tasks, working across many files, and the review patterns that make hand-offs safe. Plus the decision that matters most: when to chat, when to cowork. Live demos, minimal slides. You'll leave with use cases your users can try the same afternoon.
speakers: Microsoft MVP & Head of Modern Work

sessions.title: Make Copilot Stick: What Actually Changes User Behavior at Work
sessions.desc: Many employees try Microsoft Copilot, see potential, and then return to old habits. Why? This session explores what actually drives lasting adoption in the workplace. Drawing from real-world Copilot deployments, we'll examine the behaviors, reinforcement strategies, leadership actions, and workflow design decisions that help users turn occasional experimentation into consistent daily usage and measurable business value.

sessions.title: SharePoint Skills: AI-Powered Automation for Everyday Work
sessions.desc:
SharePoint Skills let users turn repeatable tasks, document reviews, metadata tagging, content summarization, information extraction, into reusable AI experiences anyone with the right permissions can run. Just faster, more consistent results.

In this fast-paced session, we'll cover the essentials: what Skills are, how they work, where they live, and who can create, manage, and use them. Then we'll move straight into live demos, showing you how to build Skills that solve real business problems.

sessions.title: Can You Trust Your Fabric Data Agent? Test It and Prove It
sessions.desc: A fluent answer is not the same as a correct one. In a live Fabric demonstration, we expose how broad schema selection, undefined business terms and weak examples make a data agent return plausible but wrong answers. Then we fix it: tighten the schema, improve the instructions, add example queries and rerun a fixed benchmark. The generated T-SQL stays on screen throughout. Leave able to test a Fabric data agent, measure improvement and defend the result to a business sponsor.

sessions.title: Fabric Ontology in Practice: From Data to Domain Knowledge
sessions.desc: Enterprise data often describes the same business through disconnected schemas. In this demo-driven session, build a Microsoft Fabric Ontology for an aircraft manufacturer. Model aircraft, components, suppliers, and service bulletins as shared business concepts, bind them to OneLake data, and turn fragmented data into reusable domain knowledge for analytics and AI.

sessions.title: Two Doors Out of SQL Server: Mirroring vs Change Event Streaming
sessions.desc: Not everyone's analytics estate lives in one platform. SQL Server 2025 gives you two exits: Mirroring, which lands current-state tables in OneLake, and Change Event Streaming, which pushes row-level change events to Event Hubs, where Fabric Eventstream or Azure Databricks Structured Streaming can pick them up. One is Fabric-native | the other is portable. We'll build the bronze medallion layer on both, and cover why you can only enable one per database.

sessions.title: Your Semantic Model Isn't an Ontology (Yet)
sessions.desc: You've spent years building semantic models ù but Fabric IQ Ontology asks for something different: entities, relationships, rules, and data bindings that ground AI agents in what your business actually means, not just what your tables contain. In 15 minutes, see a live before/after ù a hand-built lineage layer versus what ontology gives natively ù and get a straight answer to "do I need this yet?"

sessions.title: Make Agents Speak the Business with Fabric IQ Ontology
sessions.desc: Enterprise agents often know the data but miss its meaning. I will build a Fabric IQ ontology over operational and analytical data, connect it to a Microsoft Foundry agent through the Fabric IQ MCP tool, and test questions that require relationships, rules, and business vocabulary - not keyword matching. You will see where ontology improves an agent, where a semantic model is enough, and how to introduce a governed context layer without rebuilding the data estate.

sessions.title: Snowflake + Copilot: Workplace Context Meets Your HR System of Record
sessions.desc: Microsoft 365 Copilot already reads your workplace: the meetings, the threads, who works with whom. That is Work IQ, and it is half of an HR answer. The other half, headcount, tenure, movement and engagement, sits in Snowflake where Copilot cannot see it. This session joins them, through the Cortex Agents app inside Microsoft 365 Copilot and a Copilot Studio agent when you need control, so HR people who have never written SQL get answers carrying both the numbers and the context.

sessions.title: Boosting Your SOC with Microsoft Sentinel Data Lake & Security Copilot
sessions.desc:
Based on real-world Microsoft Sentinel deployments and day-to-day SOC operations, this session explores how Microsoft Sentinel Data Lake, AI capabilities, and Security Copilot can transform detection, investigation, and response workflows.

Whether you are planning your Sentinel Data Lake strategy or already operating a mature SOC, this session provides practical lessons learned, architectural guidance, and real operational experiences.

sessions.title: Security Copilot Blueprint: Activate, Measure, and Scale
sessions.desc: Security Copilot is reaching more teams, but successful adoption takes more than turning it on. In this demo-led session, follow a practical blueprint to activate the right experiences, measure real usage and SCU consumption, and decide when and how to scale. See how prompts, embedded experiences, and agents fit together, and leave with a repeatable approach for growing Security Copilot without losing visibility or control.

sessions.title: Shadow AI Data Leaks: Protect Data with Microsoft Purview DSPM
sessions.desc: Your employees are already using AI, whether or not IT approved it. The risk isn't AI itself, it's what happens when someone shares sensitive enterprise information with no visibility or control. In this session, we walk through a real scenario and how to protect it: an employee shares sensitive data with a third-party AI tool. You'll leave knowing how to stand up DSPM policies that protect data without slowing your teams down across third-party AI apps and agents.

sessions.title: Zero Trust objectives with Defender for Cloud CSPM and Defender EASM
sessions.desc: In addition to a SIEM, which is reactive, every shop needs insight into misconfiguration issues and compliance risks in the cloud--a logical extension of Zero Trust policies. Learn how the multi-cloud features of Defender for Cloud integrated with Defender XDR continuously monitors cloud infrastructure including DevOps platforms for gaps in security policy enforcement across all clouds and all platforms. Leverage agentless vulnerability scanning, secrets scanning, and Security Copilot plug-ins.

sessions.title: AI Without New Hardware: AI-Enabled Windows 365 Cloud PCs
sessions.desc: What if users could access Copilot+ class Windows experiences without replacing the physical PC in front of them? In this demo-led session, see how AI-enabled Windows 365 Cloud PCs can deliver capabilities such as improved Windows Search and Click to Do from the cloud. YouÆll learn how IT enables and validates these experiences in Intune and where AI-enabled Cloud PCs fit in a modern Windows strategy.

sessions.title: Your smartest colleague might be your PC
sessions.desc: Everybody's talking about AI, but many of the best productivity features are already sitting on your Windows device waiting to be used. Join this fun, demo-packed session where we'll explore Copilot on Windows, voice, Recall, Windows 365 integrations, and other hidden gems that will save time, help you work smarter and have a better day with your Windows device. No technical deep dives - just intelligent work at your fingertips.

sessions.title: Find Your Windows Cloud Community Path - Journey Beyond Ignite
sessions.desc: Discover how to stay connected with the Windows Cloud community beyond Ignite. This session will help attendees explore ways to join ongoing community programs, raise their hand for relevant private preview and product feedback opportunities, and learn how to grow their involvement through the Windows Cloud technical community programs.

sessions.title: Build and trust an AI-powered Fabric Data Agent in minutes
sessions.desc: Generative AI can help users chat with data, but how do you set it up for enterprise data and ensure the answers are accurate? In this demo you'll see how AI can accelerate the creation of a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent from an existing semantic model. Then we'll take it a step further by automatically generating and maintaining a ground truth dataset used to validate responses, improve trust, detect drift and measure agent quality at scale.

sessions.title: Data governance for the AI era: Microsoft Fabric OneLake Catalog
sessions.desc: As organizations accelerate AI adoption, trusted data has become the foundation for innovation. Join this lightning talk to discover how the OneLake Catalog reimagines data governance with a unified experience for data discovery, governance, and protection for your data estate. Learn how organizations can empower users to find trusted data faster, govern at scale with insights and recommended actions, and build an AI-ready data estate.

sessions.title: Designing resilient multi-cloud connectivity with Azure Networking
sessions.desc: Build multi-cloud applications that stay available when networks, clouds, or regions fail. Explore Azure ExpressRoute, AWS and GCP interconnects for native cloud-to-cloud connectivity, plus ExpressRoute Metro resiliency and ExpressRoute Last Mile. Through architecture walkthroughs and failure scenarios, learn practical patterns for traffic routing, rapid failover, and resilient connectivity that keep applications running across clouds and regions during disruptions.

sessions.title: Build once, deploy across AKS, ACI, and ACA with Radius
sessions.desc: Cloud-native applications often become tied to a specific runtime, making workloads difficult to move without significant rework. Radius, an open-source application platform from Azure Incubations, separates application intent from infrastructure. In this live demo, well deploy one application across AKS, ACI, and ACA using the same definition and no code changes, showing how platform teams can support multiple Azure runtimes while preserving a consistent developer experience.

sessions.title: Give your agent a thousand tools: Connectors as MCP for AI
sessions.desc: Agents are only as capable as the tools you hand them, and hand-writing tool integrations is the slowest part of building one. In fifteen minutes, we expose existing connectors as MCP tools and watch an agent take real action against real business systems, with governed authentication instead of pasted secrets. Fast, live, and designed to spark the question of what the same approach would unlock across your own systems.
speakers: Principal Product Manager | Core AI / Logic Apps

sessions.title: Redefining observability with Health Models
sessions.desc: A common observability question 'Is my system healthy, and what’s impacting its health?' Learn how Azure Monitor Health Models can help you define and track health, reduce alert noise, and move toward proactive operations with a cohesive system view, actionable insights, and faster troubleshooting.

sessions.title: Azure Local Disconnected Operations: Tenant onboarding and IDP setup
sessions.desc: Learn how tenant onboarding and identity provider (IdP) setup come together in Azure Local Disconnected Operations (ALDO). This session will walk through the end-to-end experience for bringing a tenant onto the platform, configuring identity, and preparing the tenant to securely access and manage their environment. We’ll highlight the key steps, roles, and experiences that simplify onboarding and identity setup in disconnected environments.

sessions.title: From resilience gaps to confident recovery
sessions.desc: Explore Azure’s vision for operational resilience across infrastructure and cyber recovery. See how Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager helps identify resiliency gaps, assess dependencies, validate posture, and improve preparedness. Then discover Azure Backup’s cyber recovery capabilities, including clean room recovery, to safely restore critical applications. Learn how Azure helps organizations get resilient, stay resilient, and recover confidently.

sessions.title: AI-driven attack readiness: Azure Policy and Machine Configuration
sessions.desc: Get ahead of AI-driven attacks with preventive governance, not after-the-fact cleanup. In this technical lightening talk, use Azure Policy and Machine Configuration to roll out enforcement safely at scale, enforce TLS 1.3 settings for post-quantum readiness, apply CIS, STIG, and Azure Security baselines across your VM fleet, and query centralized in-VM configuration inventory in Azure Resource Graph. Learn staged rollout and drift-prevention patterns that keep your estate hardened as it changes.

sessions.title: Understand how attackers use AI to create and evade malware
sessions.desc: AI is changing how attackers create, evade detection, and deliver malware, while giving defenders new ways to identify threats. See demonstrations of AI-assisted malware creation, exploit detection, and delivery methods, and learn how to distinguish human-driven techniques from those enabled by AI.

sessions.title: Move beyond AI pilots and build the frontier firm
sessions.desc: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.

sessions.title: Turn personal agents into enterprise assets
sessions.desc: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.

sessions.title: Your AI sounds confident, but can your bank trust it?
sessions.desc: Fluency is easy to mistake for accuracy. In banking, the distinction matters. See how enterprise AI can be grounded in trusted data, governed across complex workflows, and continuously evaluated before confidence becomes a consequence. Learn practical approaches for building AI that your organization can use with greater confidence.

sessions.title: Modernize IT service management with AI and automation
sessions.desc: AI is transforming ITSM. See how Azure AI Language and Azure AI Foundry, with deep, native integrations across Microsoft Teams, Intune, and Office 365, can help automate ticket triage, resolve requests faster, and unify service management across applications. See these capabilities in action with TeamDynamix through a no-code platform built for power without complexity and low admin overhead. Walk away with a practical, real-world blueprint for modernizing ITSM in your organization.

sessions.title: Take the mystery out of Autopilot enrollment
sessions.desc: An Autopilot enrollment is a black box: it either finishes, or it doesn't. Reconstructing what happened from logs on a wiped device can be difficult. See how Autopilot Monitor tracks enrollments live with 200+ signals per session, event timelines, automatic diagnostics, failure analytics, and fleet health. Through live demos, explore how companies and MSPs can investigate enrollment issues and query telemetry using an AI assistant over MCP.

sessions.title: Simplify identity and device migrations during business transformation
sessions.desc: Business mergers, acquisitions, and modernization demand speed and accuracy. Identity expert Conrad Murray demonstrates how PowerSyncPro automates AD synchronization and enables workstation migrations while preserving user profiles, apps, and identities. See the solution in action and learn how to simplify identity and device migrations while minimizing disruption.

sessions.title: Strong enough for the enterprise, built for IT
sessions.desc: See how a privileged access management solution delivers the security depth large organizations demand while being designed around the people who actually run IT. Watch it in action and learn how it can simplify privileged access management for your IT teams.

sessions.title: Get trusted answers to compliance questions in Copilot
sessions.desc: AI answers are only as trustworthy as the knowledge they draw from. See how getAbstract curates and verifies knowledge across industries and job roles, then brings that knowledge into Microsoft Copilot. Explore how organizations can provide role- and sector-relevant knowledge for areas such as consulting, regulatory compliance, and financial services to help users get more grounded, trusted answers.

sessions.title: Turn DNS and network data into actionable workflows
sessions.desc:
You run Microsoft DNS and DHCP. You also run everything else. That fragmentation leaves network and security teams with an incomplete view of what is on the network. 
This demo-led session shows how EfficientIP overlays Microsoft, Azure, and third-party DNS, adds IPAM and asset discovery, and builds one authoritative network view. See how that intelligence feeds network and security workflows to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and accelerate anomaly investigation.

sessions.title: Make agent-generated documents consistent and auditable
sessions.desc: LLMs are great at drafting but not designed for repeatable output. When AI generates a contract or invoice, consistency matters. See how Doctavian uses MCP to interpret intent, render deterministic output, and add eIDAS-compliant digital signatures and audit trails. Learn a practical approach to building consistent, compliant agent-driven document workflows in Microsoft 365 and beyond.

sessions.title: Know when AI should yield to human judgment
sessions.desc: AI has become remarkably capable at analysis, correlation, recommendation, and prediction. Yet the closer AI gets to decisions with real operational consequences, the more administrators insist on human authority in the final dispatch. Using 2026 survey data from more than 1,000 sysadmins, this session examines where that boundary exists, why it persists, and what it tells us about the future of autonomous IT.

sessions.title: Secure AI infrastructure on Azure
sessions.desc: Securing AI infrastructure on Azure requires consistent visibility and control. In this demonstration, see how customers can gain visibility into the AI applications running in their Azure environment. Explore transitioning from discovery to enforcement using Palo Alto Networks' firewall portfolio to apply consistent, AI-powered security policies.

sessions.title: Scale governed AI from pilots to production
sessions.desc: Many organizations have piloted AI and deployed copilots, but scaling across the enterprise requires production-grade governance. This session shares frameworks for moving from experimentation to measurable impact: governance models, LLMOps/AgentOps, risk management, and human oversight. Attendees leave with practical guidance for turning AI investments into repeatable business outcomes.

sessions.title: Overcome pricing complexity and sales inefficiency in Dynamics 365
sessions.desc: Complex companies live and die by how fast they can turn a pricing decision into a quote a buyer can act on. When pricing and quoting operate separately from CRM, handoffs can add delays and slow deals. See how Conga�s pricing and CPQ solutions work within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to bring intelligent, guided selling into the sales workflow, helping teams make informed pricing and margin decisions and move from pricing to quote more efficiently.

sessions.title: Build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start
sessions.desc: Enterprises often treat migration and governance as separate phases by moving data first and then planning to clean up permissions and compliance gaps once the dust settles. When that cleanup doesn't happen on schedule, the gap becomes a growing liability the moment AI agents and Copilot start touching that same ungoverned data. Explore how to approach migration and governance as one project and build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start.

sessions.title: Secure Copilot with lessons from real-world AI vulnerabilities
sessions.desc: As AI works across enterprise data, understanding emerging security risks is essential to using it with confidence. Explore three vulnerabilities identified by Varonis Threat Labs: Reprompt, SearchLeak, and CoSnitch, all responsibly disclosed and fixed in collaboration with Microsoft. Learn from this research and explore practical steps organizations can take to strengthen security as they adopt Microsoft Copilot.

sessions.title: Govern autonomous engineering inside your Azure tenant
sessions.desc: Bring autonomous engineering into your existing Microsoft environment with BuildEngine by Eido. Use Microsoft Foundry to access models from OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, and others while keeping execution, governance, and control inside your Azure tenant. See agents tackle real engineering tasks with Windows 365 for Agents and existing Intune policies, with human approval gates, audit history, model choice, and cost controls.

sessions.title: Transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory
sessions.desc: Building AI agents is easy. Keeping them accurate, cost-efficient, governed, reliable, and secure in production is the hard part. As AI multiplies code volume, engineering teams face "agent sprawl" and technical debt. Learn how to transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory, with real-world examples for private agent evaluations, governance, and cost management, regardless of the coding agent harness.

sessions.title: Set AI in motion with agent squads for legacy systems
sessions.desc: AI ambition is everywhere. Operational impact is not. In this session, watch a working squad of AI agents tackle one of the toughest enterprise challenges: understanding legacy systems that still run the business. Working within defined roles, tools, and guardrails, the agents analyze an unfamiliar codebase and produce a traceable inventory of business rules and risks. Learn three design principles behind the approach: composable agents, engineered context, and human oversight.

sessions.title: Manage SharePoint agents with SharePoint Advanced Management
sessions.desc: Site owners and business users can build their own agents on top of SharePoint content, creating new considerations for admins around visibility, access, and governance. In this 20-minute session, see how SharePoint Advanced Management reports, PowerShell, and the Microsoft Agent 365 control plane can help you discover and report on agents across your tenant and govern potential risks. We�ll close by showing how Syskit Point can extend these capabilities to help take agent governance further.

sessions.title: Your global admin deserves better than your everyday laptop
sessions.desc: As AI changes the threat landscape, protecting privileged access is increasingly important to an assume-breach security strategy. See how to separate privileged access from everyday work and strengthen protection beyond traditional approaches. Explore a Microsoft architecture using Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Conditional Access, and AVD to help limit lateral movement and better protect critical assets.

sessions.title: From Ticket to PR: Field Lessons from an Autonomous Code Agent
sessions.desc: What happens when an autonomous coding agent becomes part of the engineering team? For seven months, seven teams have run isolated agents 24/7, reviewing 100% of pull requests and implementing about 20% of tickets before human review. This session shares the field lessons behind that journey: where autonomy delivered value, where it broke down, where human approval remained essential, and the architectural boundaries needed to run autonomous coding safely and reliably in production.

sessions.title: Production Ready AI Agents: Identity, Containment, and Cost governance
sessions.desc: Most teams can build an agent. Far fewer can operate one safely in a shared tenant. This session takes a document-processing agent with three production defects, over-scoped permissions, an unbounded retry loop, and uncontained code execution, and remediates each live: Entra Agent ID for per-agent identity, Microsoft Execution Containers for isolation, Agent Framework circuit breakers with Application Insights, Copilot Credits attribution, and portable policy via the Agent Control Specification.

sessions.title: AI Governance Playbook: Scaling Agents Without Chaos
sessions.desc: AI agents are quickly moving from experimentation to enterprise deployment, but most organizations lack a governance model to manage them at scale. Learn how leading enterprises are governing agent lifecycles, ownership, permissions, security, compliance, and business value using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI. Leave with a practical framework to accelerate innovation while maintaining control and accountability.

sessions.title: Creating agent-ready data with Azure SQL Hyperscale & Microsoft Fabric
sessions.desc: Every organization runs on transactions, yet most still shuttle that transactional data around with fragile ETL jobs and schedulers, which often leaves AI agents making instant decisions using stale snapshots. Join us to see how Azure SQL Hyperscale, change event streaming, and Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric combine to create truly agent-ready data. Build a less fragile, event-driven architecture that keeps your agents current and your data IQ-ready.

sessions.title: Azure Unplugged: Perspectives on sovereign public cloud
sessions.desc: Join Allison Nachtigal, VP of Azure Customer and Field Experiences and Stuart Russell, VP of Engineering leading Microsoft Sovereign engineering strategy and a featured customer for an engaging Azure Unplugged conversation on the growing importance of sovereign cloud.

sessions.title: Your existing apps, your next decade of cloud-native
sessions.desc: Your existing applications still run the business. The question is what you gain from modernization and what it costs to stay put. This demo-first session shows how to move applications to Azure Container Apps without a rewrite or Kubernetes expertise. See a live containerize-and-deploy workflow, production-ready autoscaling, identity, secrets, custom domains, and scale-to-zero economics. Learn how operations change after migration and how the same platform enables AI and agent workloads.

sessions.title: Best practices for secure network architecture in the AI age
sessions.desc: AI is transforming cybersecurity on both sides of the battle. Threat actors are using AI to automate attacks, while organizations must adopt more resilient defenses. This session explores secure networking architectures for the AI era, including Zero Trust, AI workload protection, segmentation, and multi-cloud security. Learn proven patterns and customer examples for securing AI environments, reducing risk, protecting data, and accelerating AI adoption with confidence.

sessions.title: AI Infrastructure Intelligence: Powering the next generation of AI
sessions.desc: Maximizing performance, improving efficiency, increasing reliability, and simplifying operations are essential to delivering AI at scale. Join this session to see how AI Infrastructure Intelligence uses AI-driven insights and predictive analytics to help customers choose optimal AI infrastructure, maximize GPU efficiency, improve resiliency, and accelerate issue resolution. Discover how built-in intelligence across Azure AI Infrastructure helps organizations deploy faster and scale confidently.

sessions.title: Monitoring without polling: Real-time, change-driven monitoring
sessions.desc: Modern observability collects telemetry in near real time, yet many monitoring workflows rely on periodic evaluation, adding latency and missing transient or absent conditions. This talk introduces change-driven monitoring, where continuous queries evaluate system state and trigger reactions as conditions change. Using Drasi, a Microsoft-backed CNCF Sandbox project, we’ll demonstrate detection of failures, stalled workflows, missing heartbeats, and SLO violations, with alerts and self-healing.

sessions.title: Building Cost Confidence for AI Transformation
sessions.desc: As AI usage expands across users, agents, and workloads, organizations need confidence in cost planning. Join Andrews Bryant to explore AI FinOps and how AI Flex Spend Plans, usage-based billing, and Copilot Credits can help align investment with adoption. Learn practical strategies for forecasting, cost governance, consumption insights, and building greater visibility, predictability, and control.
speakers: Director GTM - SME&C AI Business Solutions

sessions.title: Skills in Microsoft Copilot
sessions.desc:
Turn the way you work into expertise Copilot can reuse. In this session, discover how skills capture your processes, examples, and standards as reusable instructions—so you spend less time explaining recurring tasks and bring a more consistent approach to everyday work.
Learn how to create, refine, and share skills across supported Microsoft 365 experiences.

sessions.title: Why AI Fails Without a Knowledge Strategy
sessions.desc:
Employees spend hours searching for information spread across emails, chats, meetings, documents, and business systems. AI can only be as effective as the knowledge it can access and understand. Discover how organizations can move beyond AI assistants that answer questions and toward AI systems that understand people, projects, content, relationships, and business context.
 
Leave with actionable next steps to help your organization unlock more value from its knowledge and AI investments.

sessions.title: Build AI-ready teams with Work IQ people and org context
sessions.desc: AI workforce transformation starts with understanding your people and the work they do. Discover how people and organizational context in Work IQ personalizes Copilot experiences with trusted answers, while helping leaders identify opportunities and redesign workflows so teams are AI-ready. Learn how organizations can move beyond AI adoption and accelerate workforce transformation with actionable insights grounded in real work.

sessions.title: Monday morning triage: from Shadow AI to Governed AI in minutes
sessions.desc: See how Microsoft Agent 365 turns Shadow AI from a blind spot into a Monday morning routine. In this live demonstration, we'll open the Shadow AI page to a named list of unmanaged agents detected across the tenant, map each to devices and users running it, block the riskiest through Intune policy, and sanction legitimate developer tools into the governed Registry, where runtime protection, data security, and access controls take over. sessions.title: From goals to done: AI-powered work management with Microsoft Planner

sessions.desc: As AI reshapes how we work, the greatest opportunities come from what people uniquely bring to the table. Explore how humans and AI can work together to drive innovation, build trust, and create impact, while strengthening the capabilities that set us apart.

sessions.title: From Skills to Opportunity: The New Talent Signal
sessions.desc: A profile tells you what someone says they know. What if it could also show what they’ve proven they can do? Explore how Microsoft, GitHub and LinkedIn can connect learning and verified proficiency to create richer talent signals and new pathways from skills to opportunity.

sessions.title: Why access isn't adoption: GitHub Learn's guide to AI enablement
sessions.desc: AI is changing how we work. Discover how GitHub Learn helps teams build practical AI skills, get more from GitHub Copilot, improve business and operational efficiency, and explore GH-700, a new certification validating AI skills beyond development.

sessions.title: Automating Development Work with Agentic Workflows
sessions.desc: GitHub Agentic Workflows embed AI agents in GitHub Actions to interpret context, choose next steps, and act within boundaries you set. Through demos of issue triage, vulnerability fixes, and dependency updates, learn to combine agent autonomy with scoped permissions, human review, and approval. You'll leave ready to build workflows that handle routine work while developers stay in control and focus on building software.

sessions.title: Copilot Studio unlocked: The new GitHub Copilot harness for makers
sessions.desc: See the new GitHub Copilot harness in action and discover what it unlocks for Copilot Studio makers. In a live demo, learn how it expands what agents can do, enables richer experiences, and changes how makers build and extend agents.

sessions.title: IT operations as AI enablement
sessions.desc: You've deployed a new product, but adoption is lagging. A simple “click here” video probably isn’t enough to get users started. Learn how IT can drive usage by becoming a champion for change and showing employees how new tools help them work smarter and get more done.

sessions.title: From VMs to Pods: A Kubernetes translation guide for IT/ops admins
sessions.desc: You already know infrastructure, networking, storage, and HA. In 25 minutes, we'll map what you know to its Kubernetes equivalent — VM to pod, load balancer to Service, disks to PersistentVolumes — so AKS feels like an evolution, not a reset.

sessions.title: AI FinOps in practice: what IT and business owe each other
sessions.desc: An IT Pro and a business pro trade perspectives on the real cost of running AI. In 25 minutes, see how token spend, model choice, and workload placement translate into budget lines — and how each side can stop surprising the other.

sessions.title: Skill or will? Diagnose what’s stalling AI adoption
sessions.desc: AI adoption can stall even after training. Learn a skill-versus-will diagnostic to identify whether a workflow is blocked by capability, confidence, permission, incentives, or design, and choose the leadership response that unlocks value.

sessions.title: Building security skills through hands-on learning
sessions.desc: As cyber threats evolve and security responsibilities expand, organizations need practical ways to help security professionals make better decisions. Explore how simulation-based learning enables learners to rehearse real-world security scenarios in a low-risk environment. From evaluating data sources and governance controls to determining when automation, AI, or human oversight is required, simulations help learners understand not just what to do, but why it matters.

sessions.title: What if your data agents spoke your business language
sessions.desc: Your data records what happened, but rarely what it means to your business. In this session we take one real business scenario and build an ontology in Fabric IQ that captures its concepts, relationships and rules, then follow it through into data agents and Foundry. Leave able to model your own domain and give your agents the vocabulary your business actually uses.

sessions.title: Behind the skills: Life of a Microsoft Certified Trainer
sessions.desc: Microsoft Certified Trainers (MCTs) help learners and organizations build critical technology skills through expert instruction and real-world experience. Hear inspiring stories of career impact, community, and the role MCTs play in Microsoft's skilling mission worldwide.
speakers: MCT, Community Lead and MCT Onboarding Advisor

sessions.title: Skills Quest live: AI Trivia Challenge
sessions.desc: Put your AI skills to the test in Skills Quest Trivia! Compete in a fast-paced challenge featuring questions on AI, Microsoft technologies, and real-world scenarios. Learn something new, show what you know, and see how your skills stack up.

sessions.title: Math in Microsoft 365: Easier to Create, Share, and Understand
sessions.desc: Math powers education, research, engineering, and business. Explore Microsoft’s latest investments in math accessibility across Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, including MathML and LaTeX support, equation editing and conversion, and structured math experiences for screen readers, collaboration, and AI. Learn how these advances help educators, students, researchers, accessibility advocates, and technical professionals create and understand math more easily.

sessions.title: Inclusive Design in Action: Building Better AI Experience for Everyone
sessions.desc: Inclusive Design is not a checklist. It’s a product development approach that helps teams build experiences that work better for more people. In this demo-driven session, learn how Inclusive Design can be applied across the product lifecycle to identify unmet needs, uncover innovation opportunities, and improve AI-powered experiences. Through real-world examples and live demos, explore practical techniques for product strategy, research, design, and development.

sessions.title: From Pilot to Productivity: AI Adoption in Action
sessions.desc: Many organizations have moved beyond experimenting with AI, and turning pilots into measurable business impact remains a challenge. Join this theater session to see live demonstrations of AI-enabled workflows and learn how organizations are building workforce readiness, driving adoption, and scaling AI across teams. Walk away with practical strategies for transforming AI from a promising technology into a daily productivity engine.

sessions.title: From Assistance to Resolution: Customer Service in Action
sessions.desc: Many organizations have deployed AI assistants, but few have unlocked true end-to-end resolution. Join this session for a hands-on look at how AI can understand intent, access business systems, execute workflows, and resolve customer requests with minimal human intervention. Through demonstrations and implementation examples, explore the architectural decisions, safeguards, and integrations required to deliver autonomous customer experiences.

sessions.title: From Reports to Reasoning: Reinventing PPM with AI and Power Apps
sessions.desc: How do you rethink project portfolio management after 20 years of doing it the same way? Join Microsoft MVP Peter Kestenholz and learn how Context& used AI, Power Platform and Dataverse to replace traditional dashboards with AI-driven insights and build a fully interactive what-if scenario engine. Real-world lessons from serving 100+ global enterprises and accelerating innovation through AI-assisted development and user experience.

sessions.title: Hardening MCP: Advanced Security and Scale for Enterprise AI Hubs
sessions.desc: Exposing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enterprise production introduces massive scalability and security hurdles. In this advanced, demo-first session, we address the architectural realities of deploying the new stateless MCP standard. Drawing from real-world FastTrack deployments, we will dissect advanced multi-tenant routing, stateless load balancing, and prompt-injection mitigation. Learn how to securely scale AI data pipelines without compromising corporate data boundaries.

sessions.title: Follow the Tokens: Finding the Real Cost of Your Foundry AI Models
sessions.desc:
You have multiple Microsoft Foundry AI model deployments, but which one is driving your costs? 
In this lightning talk, you'll learn how to uncover per-model usage costs with Azure Monitor. Through a live demo and a simple unattended .NET app, I'll show how to turn raw metrics into actionable insights for reporting, budgeting, FinOps, and governance. Take home a practical solution for your AI projects.

sessions.title: Who Owns This Agent? Identity, Data, & Control across Microsoft Clouds
sessions.desc:
Building an AI agent is easy. Governing it is the hard part.
A Microsoft Foundry agent can access Microsoft 365, Microsoft IQ data, identities, and business content across multiple platforms. But who owns it, what can it access, and how do you retire it safely? Follow a real-world agent from deployment to decommissioning and learn the four governance controls every production agent needs: Ownership, Identity, Data Boundary, and Lifecycle.

sessions.title: Essential Insights for Governing Copilot Agents
sessions.desc: Organizations are rapidly deploying Copilot agents, but many lack the governance needed to scale securely. Learn a practical framework for managing agent lifecycle, security, compliance, and operational oversight using Microsoft Purview, Copilot Studio, DLP, and governance best practices. Leave with actionable guidance for preventing agent sprawl, protecting sensitive data, and enabling innovation while maintaining control.

sessions.title: Prompt, Skill, Cowork Task, or Agent? A Four-Signal Test
sessions.desc: The most common question in the field has no documented answer. Is this a Copilot prompt, a Cowork task, a reusable skill, or a real agent? Guess wrong and you buy months of rework. I give you a routing test built on four signals: task shape, data gravity, governance burden, and reuse potential. Then I run real requests through it live, including two where the obvious answer is wrong and one I refuse to automate at all. You can apply it to your own backlog the same afternoon.

sessions.title: Scaling M365 Copilot in Finance: From Access to Impact
sessions.desc: How does a regulated financial services organization turn M365 Copilot experiments into an everyday capability? OP Pohjola, FinlandÆs largest financial services group, shares its journey from the early pilots in 2023 to organization-wide adoption in 2026. Learn the practical operating model behind training, support and communications, focusing on how to move from providing access to driving active use. See how to drive value and create measurable changes in ways of working and business outcomes.

sessions.title: Agentic Data Platforms: Reusable Architectures with Fabric IQ
sessions.desc: Multi-agent systems require repeatable architectures for business context, data connections, and governance. This session breaks down recurring reference patterns for agentic platforms built on Microsoft Fabric. Drawing on enterprise implementations, we present reusable blueprints for ontology design, agent grounding, and orchestration. Learn to combine semantic models, OneLake, and Fabric IQ into a coherent foundation for Data Agents, Copilots, and custom enterprise workflows.

sessions.title: Enterprise Data & AI with Snowflake and Databricks on Azure
sessions.desc: How do you build an AI-ready data platform when your estate spans Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks? This session examines a real enterprise architecture using medallion layers, Azure Data Lake Storage, Apache Iceberg, catalog federation, identity, and governed agent access. Learn the interoperability decisions, performance traps, and cost trade-offs that appear when multiple platform engines must operate as one trusted Data and AI ecosystem.
speakers: Azure Solution Architect at Circle K: Convenience Store & Gas Station

sessions.title: From Data to Agentic AI with Fabric
sessions.desc: Agentic AI starts with trusted data. This session shows how Microsoft Fabric helps enterprises build AI-ready data with  governance and compliance. Learn practical architecture patterns for connecting operational data to context-aware AI agents.

sessions.title: From Data to Decisions: Fabric Data Agent Meets Microsoft Foundry
sessions.desc: What if AI could understand your business data and help decide what happens next? In this demo-heavy session, weÆll use Microsoft Fabric Data Agent and Microsoft Foundry to investigate a real-world retail sales decline across sales, inventory, and operations data. Watch AI uncover causes, connect trusted enterprise context, and recommend actions. WeÆll then go beyond Q&A with secure access, orchestration, evaluation, tracing, and human oversight.

sessions.title: From Fabric Machine Learning to AI Agents with Microsoft IQ
sessions.desc: Build a customer-retention agent that turns Fabric data into action. Train a churn model with Fabric Machine Learning, enrich customer feedback at scale with AI Functions, and expose governed business context through a Fabric Data Agent and Fabric IQ, part of Microsoft IQ. Add an Agent Skill for investigation and escalation, then connect the pieces in Microsoft Foundry. See how predictions, semantic context, and reusable workflows combine to help agents reason and act on trusted enterprise data.

sessions.title: No More ETL? A Real-World Playbook for Fabric Mirroring
sessions.desc: "No more ETL" sounds great until migration week. Fabric mirroring can genuinely retire your pipelines, or quietly become the outage nobody planned for. This session is a field-tested playbook for migrating off legacy systems ETL onto Fabric mirroring: sequencing that doesn't blow up your quarter, where CDC actually saves money, and the day-one mistakes we only learned by making them. Leave with a migration plan template, not a feature tour.

sessions.title: Beyond Chatbots: Enterprise Agents Powered by Microsoft IQ
sessions.desc: Enterprise AI is shifting from assistants to agents, but agents need context to be truly intelligent. Microsoft IQ delivers that context. This session shows how Work IQ, Fabric IQ, and Foundry IQ empower agents to understand your organization's unique data, processes, and relationships. Walk away knowing how to build agentic solutions that automate workflows, break down data silos, and drive business outcomes securely and at scale.

sessions.title: Mapping the Wholesaler's Mind: Fabric IQ for Enterprise Knowledge
sessions.desc: AI initiatives struggle to scale when platforms unify where data lives, but not what it means. Disconnected tables leave agents without business context. This session shows how a German wholesaler built a unified intelligence foundation with Fabric IQ. We deconstruct designing an Ontology over existing semantic models and OneLake data. Learn how this layer fuels Data Agents and Microsoft 365 Copilot with factual context, connects business meaning, and avoids schema-centric design pitfalls.

sessions.title: Every agent is a principal now. Do you know what yours can reach?
sessions.desc: Since July 2026 every new Copilot Studio agent gets an Entra Agent ID, and you can no longer opt out. That changes what an agent is: a principal with connector scopes, Conditional Access and a lifecycle. I build one live, then switch to the admin side and show what just landed in your tenant, including the part nobody enjoys. Agents created before the rollout cannot be migrated in place. You recreate them. Leave with a list of what to check in your own tenant on Monday.

sessions.title: Secure Workplace in the AI Era: An End-to-End Live Demo
sessions.desc: Built on practical experience and proven best practices gathered since the early days of Microsoft 365, this end-to-end live demo shows how Microsoft Entra, Intune, Defender XDR, Purview, and Copilot security controls work together to create a productive and secure workplace. Gain a practical birdÆs-eye view of the Microsoft security ecosystem and understand how its technologies complement each other rather than operate as isolated products.

sessions.title: Trusting Your AI Workforce: Securing and Governing Enterprise Agents
sessions.desc:
Discover how Microsoft helps organisations securely deploy and govern AI agents using familiar security, identity, and compliance controls. Through demonstrations and customer scenarios, you'll see how Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, and Copilot Studio work together to provide visibility, governance, and security for AI-powered agents.
Join us to learn the essential practices every organisation should adopt before scaling AI agents across the enterprise.

sessions.title: Who Is This Agent? Secure MCP with Microsoft Entra Agent ID
sessions.desc: Claus Hanson at Tailspin Toys has an MCP-enabled agent that can read support cases and close them. The demo works, which is exactly when the security questions begin. Who is the agent? Whose authority is it using? What can it read? What can it call? Where is the evidence? I'll start with an overprivileged agent, then use Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Conditional Access, scoped MCP tools, and audit evidence to make its authority narrow, visible, and revocable.

sessions.title: Your Agent Has Access. Now Prove What It Did.
sessions.desc: AI agents don't just read enterprise data anymore. They act on it. In this fast-paced investigation, we follow a risky agent interaction from prompt to tool execution, then use Microsoft Purview to block sensitive data, trace agent activity, and reconstruct what happened with Audit and eDiscovery. You'll leave knowing which controls matter before, during, and after an agent acts.

sessions.title: Windows 365 for Agents in Action: Automating the App With No API
sessions.desc: Your most important business system is fifteen years old, has no API, and nobody will sign off replacing it. So people do the clicking. Windows 365 for Agents changes that. The agent checks out a real Entra-joined, Intune-managed Cloud PC, does the work a person would, and hands it back. I will show an agent we built and now run internally that stands up projects across three systems, then build the same pattern live against a legacy desktop app. Including where it breaks and what a run costs.

sessions.title: Windows 365 to the rescue:How We Escaped a 12k Seat EUC Renewal
sessions.desc:
Soaring renewal quotes. Multi-year lock-ins. All-you-can-eat licenses that leave a bitter after-taste. When private-equity-owned EUC vendors rewrite the rules, your IT budget can quickly become their growth strategy.

This is the real-world story of a 12k-seat renewal that became a six-month migration race. Learn how we HDeXited, How Windows 365 provided the escape route, and the practical decisions, trade-offs, and lessons that got us out.

sessions.title: Your Windows 365 Cloud PC Is Compromised. Now What?
sessions.desc: What happens when the endpoint at risk is a Windows 365 Cloud PC? In this demo-led session, watch a healthy Cloud PC encounter a simulated threat and follow the resulting Defender risk, Intune compliance, and Entra Conditional Access signals. YouÆll see how Cloud PCs fit into a Zero Trust security model and leave with a practical pattern for detecting, containing, and recovering cloud-hosted Windows endpoints.

sessions.title: Scale enterprise AI with security, sovereignty, and governance
sessions.desc: Organizations are accelerating AI adoption to boost productivity and unlock new value, but many are not prepared for the security, governance, and compliance risks that come with AI-driven access to data and systems. Learn what it takes to deploy enterprise AI securely at scale while maintaining control over data sovereignty, governance, and compliance requirements. Explore the foundations needed to protect data, manage risk, and build a trusted enterprise AI strategy.

sessions.title: Connect people, spaces, and AI for better workplace experiences
sessions.desc: The AI-Powered Workplace extends beyond applications into physical spaces. Learn how Q-SYS and Microsoft help organizations create high-performance workplaces that connect people, technology, and AI. Through a real customer example, see how a software-based approach simplifies management and delivers measurable business outcomes. Leave with a blueprint for transforming your workplace into an AI-powered environment that drives productivity and is ready for the future of collaboration.

sessions.title: Secure workplace AI without slowing innovation
sessions.desc: AI tools have the power to transform organizational productivity while exponentially increasing risk. Uncover how workplace AI tools can expose sensitive data, bypass controls, and introduce new attack surfaces. Explore what you can do to mitigate these risks effectively without impeding innovation.

sessions.title: Move beyond AI pilots and build the frontier firm
sessions.desc: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.

sessions.title: Turn personal agents into enterprise assets
sessions.desc: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.

sessions.title: Your cloud. Your path. Your pace.
sessions.desc: There's no single right speed for moving to the cloud. Explore how to modernize desktop delivery today, using AVD Hybrid as a bridge or Windows Cloud as the destination, and build the path that fits where you are now.

sessions.title: Scale AI agents with visibility, governance, and cost control
sessions.desc: As organizations adopt AI agents, copilots, and generative AI, visibility, governance, and cost control become increasingly important. Learn how to discover AI usage, understand token consumption, optimize costs, and govern access at scale. Through practical examples and real-world insights, you'll gain strategies for managing AI investments, reducing risk, and establishing accountability across the enterprise.

sessions.title: Modernize industrial architecture for AI-powered operations
sessions.desc: AI is only as effective as the data, architecture, and domain expertise behind it. See how Baker Hughes and EPAM are modernizing industrial software architecture, streamlining data strategies, and building a foundation for AI-powered operations. Explore approaches to platform simplification, trusted analytics, security, scalability, and user experience design to prepare industrial platforms for intelligent operations.

sessions.title: Move from AI proof of concepts to enterprise-grade production on Ubuntu
sessions.desc: AI stacks are complex, interdependent, and high stakes. Spinning an AI prototype is easy making it enterprise-ready is much more challenging. Many organizations can�t keep track of their dependencies within their AI projects, leading to solutions that fail security checks and break easily. How do you move to a robust, secure AI solution that is built to last? Learn how to architect, secure, and maintain a resilient enterprise-grade AI infrastructure on Ubuntu, without sacrificing speed.

sessions.title: Turn Oracle data in Azure into intelligent AI-powered workflows
sessions.desc: Start using business-critical data to fuel your AI journey. Discover how migrating Oracle workloads to Azure with Oracle AI Database@Azure enables Azure AI services like Microsoft IQ and Copilot to securely and instantly access enterprise data. Explore how collocating Oracle infrastructure in Azure data centers and natively integrating Oracle and Azure services powers innovation by turning trusted data into intelligent agentic workflows.

sessions.title: A practical 3 step approach to operationalize AI trust
sessions.desc: Organizations are rapidly adopting AI agents, but confidence in AI strategies often outpaces the controls needed to manage risk. That gap between confidence and control is where AI agents can start acting outside their intended scope. Join Microsoft RD and MVP Dux Raymond Sy for a practical session on three steps to operationalize AI trust before an agent does something nobody planned for. Leave with a repeatable framework you can apply to your riskiest AI agent this week.

sessions.title: Catch synthetic identity rings at scale
sessions.desc: Most identity failures don't look like identity failures. A fraud ring looks like forty new customers. A repeat shopper with three cards looks like three people. Either way, it's scattered records, not the person behind them. In this session with Senzing, learn how entity resolution closes that gap in real time on Azure, turning millions of records into true identities as data arrives, on the risk side or the revenue side. You'll leave with a blueprint and three questions for your team.

sessions.title: Accelerate Microsoft AVD and Windows 365 adoption
sessions.desc: Microsoft AVD and Windows 365 adoption is accelerating, but migration complexity, costs, and ongoing operations can slow progress. See how Liquidware helped three enterprise customers deliver applications, profiles, and a consistent user experience across AVD, Windows 365, and physical PCs. Learn how to resolve issues faster, connect experience and cost insights, and get a first look at new ways to simplify AVD management and optimization.
speakers: Sr. Solutions Architect | Office of the CTO

sessions.title: Your file estate has a second audience now. Is it ready for Copilot?
sessions.desc: Copilot and enterprise agents are creating a second audience for your file estate, with different access patterns and governance considerations. Serving that second audience doesn’t require a second copy or a second permission model. See how enterprises on Azure activate one file estate for fast, VPN-less access for people and governed, permission-aware access for AI. Then measure your approach against PSYCHIC, a vendor-neutral framework for understanding what enterprise AI needs from file data.

sessions.title: Extend Microsoft Copilot and Windows from software to workspace
sessions.desc: Discover how Logitech devices and software extend Windows and Microsoft Copilot into everyday workflows. See how Smart Actions, custom integrations, and Logitech tools help streamline tasks across Microsoft 365, GitHub, VS Code, and more. Learn how organizations can simplify repetitive work, improve productivity, and create seamless AI-powered experiences across the desktop, then get a glimpse of what's next.

sessions.title: Strengthen data resilience for Microsoft Copilot and AI
sessions.desc: Microsoft Copilot and AI depend on grounding data across M365, Azure, and SaaS. How that data is accessed, governed, and secured is becoming more critical. Cyberattacks, compromised identities, or overprivileged agents threaten that data and business continuity. Explore why data resilience must evolve for this new threat landscape and what organizations can do to better protect the data that powers AI.

sessions.title: Defend against vibe-coded Microsoft 365 attacks
sessions.desc: Cyber threats are evolving as AI reshapes adversary tradecraft. Through the lens of Phishing-as-a-Service, explore the shift from legacy tools to emerging vibe-coded adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) platforms. Huntress research on Knight Office reveals how these toolkits bypass MFA and hijack Microsoft 365 session tokens. Learn from real-world incident data how organizations can improve resilience and how Huntress and Microsoft work together to help protect Microsoft 365 environments.

sessions.title: Simplify recovery with an Azure-native approach
sessions.desc: AI is increasing reliance on cloud services, data, and identities while raising the cost of disruption. Yet recovery is often managed outside the cloud platforms organizations depend on every day. See how Microsoft and Commvault bring recovery directly into Azure through Commvault Cloud, an Azure Native ISV Service. Learn how a native approach can simplify operations, protect critical workloads, accelerate recovery, and strengthen the cloud foundation supporting AI-powered business initiatives.

sessions.title: Strengthen Copilot agent security with trusted data
sessions.desc: Enterprises deploying Copilot and Copilot Studio agents move faster when built on trusted data foundations. See how Cyera and Microsoft work together to provide classification-aware context that strengthens Copilot Studio guardrails and helps security teams approve deployments faster. Discover every agent across your Microsoft estate, understand what data each can access, and reinforce runtime protection, including a live demonstration of agent quarantine grounded in trusted data classification.

sessions.title: Redefine connectivity for frontier firms
sessions.desc: As AI moves into production, enterprises must securely connect workloads across clouds, private infrastructure, AI platforms, and the edge. See how Microsoft Azure and Equinix provide a connectivity foundation that evolves with AI demands. Experience a live demo of Equinix Fabric One connecting Azure to distributed data while extending connectivity across multicloud, neoclouds, and private infrastructure, keeping sensitive data where it is needed most.

sessions.title: How Commvault reduced cloud storage costs by 40%
sessions.desc: Commvault manages petabytes of data at scale, making the optimization of storage costs without compromising performance and resiliency a top priority. In this session, Karunakar Bojjireddy from Commvault and Vatsal Rastogi from Lucidity will share how Commvault improved storage efficiency to nearly 90% and reduced its cloud storage costs by 40%. See the approach they took and gain practical insights for optimizing storage at scale.

sessions.title: Turn Microsoft 365 into the foundation for secure AI services
sessions.desc: The Microsoft 365 tenant is your customers' most critical piece of infrastructure. It's the focal point for identity, data, endpoints, communications, and now AI. Yet many MSPs still aren't managing that stack proactively. Join inforcer co-founder Will Connor to see how MSPs are building a complete management layer across Microsoft 365, strengthening security and governance while creating a foundation for secure AI services delivered consistently at scale.

sessions.title: Deploy intelligent SRE for autonomous cloud ops
sessions.desc: As Azure environments get more complex, teams need to manage increasing alerts while maintaining context to act quickly. See three capabilities in action from Dynatrace and Microsoft: The Dynatrace Clouds App for AI-powered visibility across Azure; the Azure SRE Agent for autonomous, AI-guided incident resolution; and Dynatrace MCP integration with Microsoft Copilot for in-workflow observability. These capabilities help teams respond faster, reduce toil, and innovate with confidence.

sessions.title: Scale AI delivery with forward deployed engineering on Azure
sessions.desc: Coding agents can accelerate prototyping, but moving AI solutions into production requires architecture, security, governance, and deep business context. Learn how Fujitsu applies its forward deployed engineering approach alongside customers across manufacturing, financial services, retail, and other industries to deliver enterprise-scale AI on Azure. Discover how customer domain expertise, systems integration experience, and an AI-native platform help turn promising AI ideas into production-rea

sessions.title: Build agentic workflows with Microsoft Agent 365 and n8n
sessions.desc: Enterprises want agents that get work done, not just answer questions. Building them requires identity, access, and orchestration. Microsoft Agent 365 provides identity and access, giving agents a Microsoft 365 presence, while n8n provides orchestration to reason over requests and act across your stack. See a workflow built live, what's GA today versus in Frontier preview, and practical lessons for building your first agentic workflow.

sessions.title: Protect your software supply chain from agents of chaos
sessions.desc: AI agents are changing how software is developed and introducing new considerations for software supply chain security. Security and engineering leaders need visibility into what enters their software supply chain and whether it can be trusted. See why scan-and-patch approaches can fall short and how trusted open source and Microsoft Defender for Cloud can help teams strengthen security on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

sessions.title: How multimodal AI transforms property inspections at Ryan Specialty
sessions.desc: Property inspections often require inspectors to gather and review information across photos, documents, forms, and notes. Learn how Ryan Specialty uses multimodal agents built with Azure AI Foundry to streamline this process. Discover how AI generates inspection checklists and recommendations from multiple data sources while keeping humans in the approval loop. Attendees will gain insights into using multimodal AI and agentic workflows to automate complex business processes.

sessions.title: Turn your network into the strategic control point for AI
sessions.desc: AI is changing what organizations need from their networks. As AI expands across users, data, applications, and clouds, organizations need greater visibility, control, and insight to manage AI at scale. Learn how AI-grade networking can become a control point for AI, helping organizations strengthen security and governance, optimize performance, and build a foundation for sustainable AI growth.

sessions.title: Build resilience and recover Microsoft operations after compromise
sessions.desc: If Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID were compromised tomorrow, how quickly can your organization restore trusted operations? In this session, explore a practical cyber resilience framework for Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, and Entra ID. Learn how to protect critical data, detect threats across your Microsoft environment, and recover trusted applications, identities, and data with confidence, using immutable recovery points, threat-informed recovery, and resilient infrastructure.

sessions.title: Copilot readiness doesn't stay ready
sessions.desc: A tenant certified as Copilot-ready in March is only as ready as its configuration and identities are today. Discover why Copilot readiness is not a one-time milestone and explore practical ways to keep pace with changes across your Microsoft 365 environment.

sessions.title: AI changed what attackers find. It didn't change how they move.
sessions.desc: Frontier AI changed what attackers can find and how quickly they can weaponize it. It did not change how attacks spread. Someone still has to move laterally to reach critical systems and data. See how Illumio Insights uses real-time east-west traffic across cloud and on-prem environments to identify lateral movement risk, validate segmentation, and prioritize remediation.

sessions.title: Get a full view of your IT estate with Microsoft and NinjaOne
sessions.desc: Managing Entra, Intune, Windows 365 Business, and Azure can require IT teams to work across multiple administration experiences. See how NinjaOne works across your Microsoft estate to connect endpoint operations and data. In this live demo, see Entra ID backup, Intune device enrollment, NinjaOne deployment on Windows 365 Cloud PCs, and Azure integration. Learn how connected endpoint data can help your teams save time and reduce risk.

sessions.title: Microsoft 365 knows more than your workplace shows
sessions.desc: Microsoft 365 holds valuable signals about availability, calendars, meetings, and collaboration, but that context often stays behind a screen. This session explores how organizations can extend Microsoft 365 intelligence into desks, rooms, and shared spaces. Embrava will demonstrate practical ways to make workplace information visible and actionable where employees need it, creating a more connected physical workplace by making Microsoft 365 insights visible and actionable where employees work.

sessions.title: Apply quantum AI to complex business decisions
sessions.desc: AI, copilots, and agents are helping businesses work more efficiently.
